items.title: Regulatory Alignment for Predictable and Immediate Device Coverage Pathway (CMS-3487-NC) Procedural Notice Inviting Comment
items.summary: CMS has issued a procedural notice inviting public comment on the Regulatory Alignment for Predictable and Immediate Device Coverage Pathway (CMS-3487-NC), aimed at streamlining Medicare coverage for certain medical devices.
items.curatedReason: 这份 CMS 公告草案事关医疗器械的医保覆盖路径。如果最终通过，它将简化新设备的审批和报销流程，对提供相关创新物理治疗器械的诊所和医院将是利好，但暂时仍处于征求意见阶段。
items.titleZh: CMS 就医疗器械可预测和即时覆盖路径的监管协调征求意见
items.summaryZh: 美国医保与医助服务中心（CMS）发布程序性通知，就“医疗器械可预测和即时覆盖路径的监管协调”（CMS-3487-NC）征求公众意见，旨在简化部分医疗器械的医保覆盖流程。
items.curatedReasonEn: This draft CMS notice concerns the Medicare coverage pathway for medical devices. If finalized, it will streamline approval and reimbursement for new devices, benefiting clinics and hospitals that offer innovative physical therapy devices. However, it is currently in the public comment phase.

items.title: Supreme Court seeks compliance affidavits on Allied Healthcare Professions Act implementation
items.summary: The Indian Supreme Court has ordered the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions and state governments to file compliance affidavits on the implementation of the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions Act, 2021.
items.curatedReason: 印度最高法院要求国家专职医疗与健康专业委员会以及各邦政府提交宣誓书，详细说明《2021 年国家专职医疗与健康专业法案》的实施进展。这表明印度政府正在积极推动相关法律的落地，对在印度执业的物理治疗师来说，这意味着执业环境的规范化和标准化，你需要持续关注其进展。
items.titleZh: 印度最高法院要求提交《专职医疗与健康专业法案》实施宣誓书
items.summaryZh: 印度最高法院已下令国家专职医疗与健康专业委员会及各邦政府提交宣誓书，说明《2021 年国家专职医疗与健康专业法案》的实施情况。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Indian Supreme Court has mandated the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions and state governments to submit affidavits detailing the implementation of the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions Act, 2021. This indicates that the Indian government is actively promoting the enactment of relevant laws. For physical therapists practicing in India, this signifies the standardization and normalization of the practice environment, and you need to continue to monitor its progress.

items.title: Article - Billing and Coding: MolDX: Molecular Syndromic Panels for Infectious Disease Pathogen Identification Testing (A58720)
items.summary: A draft article from CMS discusses billing and coding for MolDX: Molecular Syndromic Panels for Infectious Disease Pathogen Identification Testing (A58720), indicating potential policy updates in diagnostic test reimbursement.
items.curatedReason: 这份 CMS 草案文章涉及分子诊断面板的编码和计费，虽然与物理治疗核心业务无直接关系，但它反映了美国医疗保险在精细化诊断测试上的政策动向。作为诊所所有者，你需要关注这类政策变化，了解未来诊断环节可能对你执业环境产生的影响。
items.titleZh: CMS 计费和编码草案：MolDX 感染性疾病分子诊断面板
items.summaryZh: CMS 发布了一份关于 MolDX 感染性疾病分子诊断面板（A58720）的计费和编码草案，预示着诊断测试报销政策可能更新。
items.curatedReasonEn: This CMS draft article on coding and billing for molecular syndromic panels is not directly related to core physical therapy services. Still, it reflects policy trends in US Medicare for refined diagnostic testing. As a clinic owner, you need to monitor such policy changes to understand the potential impact of future diagnostic developments on your practice environment.

items.title: External validation of the minimal important change in the Berg Balance Scale scores of patients hospitalized for subacute stroke.
items.summary: A longitudinal study of 286 subacute stroke patients validated minimal important change (MIC) values for the Berg Balance Scale (BBS), confirming that ≥2, ≥5, and ≥9-point thresholds are consistent across walking-ability subgroups.
items.curatedReason: 本研究验证了亚急性卒中患者 Berg 平衡量表 (BBS) 最小重要改变值的外推性。在临床评估和疗效判断时，可参考 ≥2、≥5 和 ≥9 分的阈值，这些值在不同步行能力亚组中也表现出一致性，为你的康复目标设定提供了更坚实的依据。
items.titleZh: 亚急性卒中住院患者 Berg 平衡量表最小重要改变值的外验证
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 286 例亚急性卒中患者的纵向研究验证了 Berg 平衡量表 (BBS) 的最小重要改变值 (MIC)，结果显示 ≥2、≥5 和 ≥9 分的阈值在不同步行能力亚组中均表现出一致性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study validates the generalizability of minimal important change (MIC) values for the Berg Balance Scale (BBS) in subacute stroke patients. When assessing clinical outcomes, you can confidently refer to the ≥2, ≥5, and ≥9 point thresholds, as they demonstrate consistency across different walking ability subgroups, providing a more robust basis for your rehabilitation goal setting.
items.limitation: 研究为单中心观察性研究，可能存在一定的选择偏倚，且不同步行能力亚组间的样本量差异可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center observational study, which may introduce selection bias, and differences in sample sizes among walking ability subgroups could impact the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Short-term inspiratory muscle training, aerobic exercise, and detraining in women with COPD: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial investigated the effects of short-term inspiratory muscle training, aerobic exercise, and detraining in women with COPD.
items.curatedReason: 这项随机对照试验表明，短期吸气肌训练和有氧运动对慢阻肺（COPD）女性患者有效，即使停训后仍有一定益处，为你将这些干预纳入 COPD 康复计划提供了实践依据。
items.titleZh: 短期吸气肌训练、有氧运动及停训对慢阻肺女性患者的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验研究了短期吸气肌训练、有氧运动及停训对慢阻肺（COPD）女性患者的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This randomized controlled trial shows that short-term inspiratory muscle training and aerobic exercise are effective for women with COPD, with some benefits persisting after detraining, providing practical evidence for you to incorporate these interventions into COPD rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: 研究对象为女性 COPD 患者，结果对男性患者或不同疾病严重程度的患者外推时需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study involved female COPD patients, so results should be extrapolated with caution to male patients or those with different disease severities.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Altered inter-joint coordination strategies of the lower extremity and pelvis in elite rowers with chronic low back pain
items.summary: This study investigated altered inter-joint coordination strategies of the lower extremity and pelvis in elite rowers experiencing chronic low back pain, identifying specific biomechanical differences.
items.curatedReason: 精英赛艇运动员的慢性腰痛可能与特定的下肢和骨盆协调策略改变有关。在评估这类患者时，你应当关注其生物力学模式，这提示我们康复干预可能需要更精细的生物力学分析。
items.titleZh: 精英赛艇运动员慢性腰痛时下肢和骨盆的关节间协调策略改变
items.summaryZh: 这项研究调查了患有慢性腰痛的精英赛艇运动员下肢和骨盆关节间协调策略的改变，识别了特定的生物力学差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals altered lower extremity and pelvic coordination strategies in elite rowers with chronic low back pain, helping you understand biomechanical compensation patterns in this specific athletic population.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性研究，样本量和数据分析方法未在摘要中明确提及，无法确定因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This is an observational study; sample size and data analysis methods were not specified in the abstract, limiting the ability to determine causality.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Low‐intensity focused ultrasound neuromodulation for drug‐resistant epilepsy: A randomized, sham‐controlled crossover trial
items.summary: A randomized, sham-controlled crossover trial found low-intensity focused ultrasound neuromodulation safe and well tolerated for drug-resistant epilepsy, with delayed seizure reduction suggesting potential sustained effects, though primary analysis lacked statistical significance.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 虽未在主要分析中显示统计学显著性，但证实低强度聚焦超声神经调控治疗难治性癫痫是安全的且耐受性良好。此外，其提示的延迟性癫痫发作减少值得你持续关注，这可能意味着治疗存在潜在的持续效应，仍有进一步研究的价值。
items.titleZh: 低强度聚焦超声神经调控治疗难治性癫痫：一项随机、假对照交叉试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机、假对照交叉试验发现，低强度聚焦超声神经调控治疗难治性癫痫安全且耐受性良好，虽主要分析未达统计学显著性，但延迟性癫痫发作减少提示其潜在的持续效应。
items.curatedReasonEn: While this RCT did not show statistical significance in its primary analysis, it confirms that low-intensity focused ultrasound neuromodulation for drug-resistant epilepsy is safe and well-tolerated. Furthermore, the suggested delayed seizure reduction is worth your continued attention, as it may imply potential sustained effects, meriting further research.
items.limitation: 主要交叉分析未显示统计学显著疗效，且需要更大规模、更长随访期的平行组试验来证实延迟效应和长期疗效。
items.limitationEn: The primary crossover analysis did not show statistically significant efficacy, and larger parallel-group trials with longer observation periods are needed to confirm delayed effects and long-term efficacy.

items.title: Network analysis of frailty, sleep quality, and life satisfaction in older patients: a cross-sectional study stratified by chronic disease burden
items.summary: This cross-sectional study used network analysis to examine the interplay of frailty, sleep quality, and life satisfaction in older patients, stratified by chronic disease burden.
items.curatedReason: 这项基于网络分析的横断面研究揭示了老年患者衰弱、睡眠质量和生活满意度之间的复杂关联，特别是在不同慢性病负担下，有助于你更全面地理解老年综合征。
items.titleZh: 老年患者衰弱、睡眠质量和生活满意度的网络分析：一项按慢性病负担分层的横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究采用网络分析法，探讨了老年患者衰弱、睡眠质量和生活满意度之间的相互作用，并根据慢性病负担进行了分层。
items.curatedReasonEn: This network analysis-based cross-sectional study reveals complex associations between frailty, sleep quality, and life satisfaction in older patients, especially under varying chronic disease burdens, helping you to understand geriatric syndromes more comprehensively.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法建立因果关系，且可能存在未测量混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: This study's cross-sectional design prevents establishing causality, and unmeasured confounding factors may exist.

items.title: Development of the football tactical skills scale and comparison of scores across player and training characteristics
items.summary: This study describes the development of a football tactical skills scale and compares scores across player and training characteristics.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提出了足球战术技能量表的开发和应用，为你评估运动员战术表现提供了潜在工具，但其临床转化价值仍需更多验证。
items.titleZh: 足球战术技能量表的开发及在不同球员和训练特征间的比较
items.summaryZh: 本研究描述了足球战术技能量表的开发，并比较了不同球员和训练特征间的得分。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study presents the development and application of a football tactical skills scale, offering you a potential tool for evaluating athlete tactical performance, though its clinical translation value requires further validation.
items.limitation: 本研究关注量表开发和比较，而非直接的干预效果，且为观察性研究，结论的因果推断能力有限。
items.limitationEn: This study focuses on scale development and comparison rather than direct intervention effects, and as an observational study, its causal inference capability is limited.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Simplifying ICF Assessment for Individuals with Spinal Cord Injury with Lower Limb Dysfunction Using Item Response Theory and Graphical Models.
items.summary: This multicenter cross-sectional study developed and validated a parameterized assessment tool for individuals with spinal cord injury (SCI) with lower limb dysfunction, based on the ICF, using item response theory (IRT) and graphical modeling (GM). The study involved 252 participants from multiple rehabilitation centers in China.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究利用先进的心理测量学方法，为脊髓损伤患者下肢功能障碍的 ICF 评估提供了一个更精简、标准化的工具。在临床中，这意味着你可能能用更高效的方式来评估患者的功能状态，但记住这还处于工具开发阶段。
items.titleZh: 基于项目反应理论和图模型简化脊髓损伤患者下肢功能障碍的 ICF 评估
items.summaryZh: 这项多中心横断面研究旨在开发和验证一个基于 ICF、利用项目反应理论（IRT）和图模型（GM）的脊髓损伤患者下肢功能障碍参数化评估工具。该研究纳入了来自中国多个康复中心的 252 名参与者。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study offers a streamlined, standardized ICF assessment tool for lower limb dysfunction in SCI patients using advanced psychometrics. Clinically, this could mean more efficient functional status assessment, but remember this is still in the tool development phase.
items.limitation: 研究为横断面设计，且工具尚处于开发和验证阶段，需进一步的前瞻性研究和临床应用检验。
items.limitationEn: The study is cross-sectional, and the tool is still in development and validation, requiring further prospective research and clinical application testing.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Understanding the family planning experiences and information needs of people living with multiple sclerosis: an Australian cohort study.
items.summary: This Australian cross-sectional cohort study, involving 270 participants from the Australian Multiple Sclerosis Longitudinal Study (mean age 42.7 years), investigated the impact of MS on family planning experiences and information needs. Nearly half (44.0%) reported MS impacting reproductive decisions, with 14.7% deciding against having children due to MS.
items.curatedReason: 这项澳大利亚队列研究揭示了多发性硬化症（MS）患者在生育决策上面临的挑战和信息需求。作为 PT，你在与 MS 患者沟通时，应注意他们可能存在的生育顾虑，并在专业允许范围内提供相关资源或转诊建议，以更好地支持他们的整体生活质量。
items.titleZh: 了解多发性硬化症患者的生育计划经验和信息需求：一项澳大利亚队列研究
items.summaryZh: 这项澳大利亚横断面队列研究纳入了 270 名澳大利亚多发性硬化症纵向研究的参与者（平均年龄 42.7 岁），旨在了解 MS 对生育计划经验的影响和信息需求。近一半（44.0%）的受访者表示 MS 影响了其生育决策，其中 14.7% 因 MS 决定不生育。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Australian cohort study highlights challenges and information needs for people with multiple sclerosis (MS) regarding reproductive decisions. As a PT, when communicating with MS patients, be aware of their potential fertility concerns and, within your scope, offer relevant resources or referral advice to better support their overall quality of life.
items.limitation: 研究为横断面设计，无法建立因果关系，且数据依赖自我报告。
items.limitationEn: The study is cross-sectional, precluding causal inference, and relies on self-reported data.

items.title: Effects of sportsmetrics training on biomechanical and functional performance outcomes related to ACL injury risk: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis investigated the effects of Sportsmetrics training on biomechanical and functional performance outcomes related to ACL injury risk.
items.curatedReason: Sportsmetrics 训练确实能改善与 ACL 损伤风险相关的生物力学和功能表现。鉴于这是高质量系统综述（评分 85），你可以考虑在青少年运动员的 ACL 预防方案中纳入 Sportsmetrics。
items.titleZh: Sportsmetrics 训练对 ACL 损伤风险相关生物力学和功能表现结局的影响：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析评估了 Sportsmetrics 训练对与前交叉韧带 (ACL) 损伤风险相关的生物力学和功能表现结局的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: Sportsmetrics training effectively improves biomechanical and functional performance outcomes linked to ACL injury risk. Given this is a high-quality systematic review (score 85), you should consider incorporating Sportsmetrics into ACL prevention programs for adolescent athletes.
items.limitation: 综述纳入研究的异质性可能影响了结果的统一性。
items.limitationEn: The heterogeneity of included studies in the review might affect the consistency of results.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Change in Mental Health and Resilience in Childhood Cancer Survivors After Attending a Person-Centred State-of-the-Art Late Effects Clinic-on Behalf of the PanCareFollowUp Consortium
items.summary: An observational study investigated changes in mental health and resilience in childhood cancer survivors after attending a person-centered state-of-the-art late effects clinic.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察研究表明，参加以患者为中心的先进晚期效应诊所可以改善儿童癌症幸存者的心理健康和韧性。你可以将这类综合性、以患者为中心的护理模式纳入考虑，以期提升你所管理儿童癌症幸存者的生活质量。
items.titleZh: 参加以患者为中心的先进晚期效应诊所后儿童癌症幸存者心理健康和韧性的变化
items.summaryZh: 一项观察性研究评估了儿童癌症幸存者在参加以患者为中心的先进晚期效应诊所后，其心理健康和韧性的变化情况。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study indicates that attending a person-centered state-of-the-art late effects clinic can improve mental health and resilience in childhood cancer survivors. You can consider incorporating such comprehensive, person-centered care models to enhance the quality of life for the childhood cancer survivors you manage.
items.limitation: 作为观察性研究，难以建立直接的因果关系。
items.limitationEn: As an observational study, it is difficult to establish a direct causal relationship.

items.title: Exercise training during hospitalization in community-acquired pneumonia: effects on functional ability, body composition, and physical activity level
items.summary: Research published in Aging Clinical and Experimental Research investigated the effects of exercise training during hospitalization for community-acquired pneumonia on functional ability, body composition, and physical activity level.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，在社区获得性肺炎住院期间进行运动训练，可改善患者的功能能力、身体成分和身体活动水平。你可以将早期康复干预纳入这类住院患者的管理，以促进其恢复。
items.titleZh: 社区获得性肺炎住院期间运动训练对功能能力、身体成分和身体活动水平的影响
items.summaryZh: 发表在《老化临床与实验研究》上的研究探讨了社区获得性肺炎患者住院期间进行运动训练，对其功能能力、身体成分和身体活动水平的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that exercise training during hospitalization for community-acquired pneumonia can improve patients' functional ability, body composition, and physical activity levels. You can integrate early rehabilitation interventions into the management of such hospitalized patients to promote their recovery.
items.limitation: 研究未明确提及对照组设置，可能影响结果的独立归因。
items.limitationEn: The study does not explicitly mention the control group setup, which may affect the independent attribution of results.

items.title: Effects of transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS ... - BMJ Open
items.summary: A double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled study investigated the effects of transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) and concurrent cognitive training on episodic memory in patients with traumatic brain injury.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 探索了经颅直流电刺激 (tDCS) 与认知训练对创伤性脑损伤患者情景记忆的影响。尽管是早期研究，但它提示了新的非药物干预组合的潜力，为你未来综合治疗方案的考虑提供了一个方向。
items.titleZh: 经颅直流电刺激 (tDCS) 联合认知训练对创伤性脑损伤患者情景记忆的影响：一项随机对照研究
items.summaryZh: 一项双盲、随机、安慰剂对照研究评估了经颅直流电刺激 (tDCS) 联合同期认知训练对创伤性脑损伤患者情景记忆的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT explores the effects of transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) combined with cognitive training on episodic memory in traumatic brain injury patients. Although an early study, it suggests the potential of new non-pharmacological intervention combinations, offering a direction for your future consideration of comprehensive treatment plans.
items.limitation: 样本量较小，结果可能需要大型研究进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The sample size is relatively small, and results may require further validation in larger studies.

items.title: Test-Retest Reliability of Hierarchical Proprioception Assessment of the Wrist
items.summary: This study evaluated the within-day test-retest reliability of three robotic wrist tasks—joint detection threshold (JDT), same-frame joint-to-joint matching (J-to-J), and cross-frame joint-to-visual matching (J-to-V)—in 20 neurotypical adults.
items.curatedReason: 腕关节本体感觉评估的层级任务（运动检测、关节位置匹配、跨参照系匹配）的信效度研究仍然稀缺。本研究提供了不同类型任务的信度数据，可作为你选择临床评估工具的参考。
items.titleZh: 腕关节分级本体感觉评估的重测信度
items.summaryZh: 这项研究评估了20名神经正常成年人进行的三种机器人腕关节任务（关节检测阈值、同框架关节匹配、跨框架关节-视觉匹配）的日内重测信度，以比较不同层级本体感觉判断的表现。
items.curatedReasonEn: Hierarchical proprioception assessment for the wrist, covering tasks like movement detection, joint position matching, and cross-reference frame matching, still lacks robust psychometric data. This study provides reliability data for different task types, informing your choice of clinical assessment tools.
items.limitation: 本研究的局限在于样本量较小，且研究对象为神经正常成人，结果外推至不同患者群体需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study is limited by its small sample size and enrollment of neurotypical adults, so results should be cautiously generalized to diverse patient populations.

items.title: The Influence of Hand Muscle Fatigue on Fine Motor Performance During Selected Activities of Daily Living in Healthy Adults.
items.summary: This study investigated whether hand muscle fatigue impairs fine motor performance in 30 healthy university students during 11 ADL-inspired tasks, comparing task scores and completion times pre- and post-fatigue.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，手部肌肉疲劳可能足以影响健康成年人的精细运动表现。在评估患者手部功能障碍时，你应将肌肉疲劳作为一个潜在的混杂因素考虑在内。
items.titleZh: 手部肌肉疲劳对健康成年人部分日常生活活动精细运动表现的影响
items.summaryZh: 这项研究评估了30名健康大学生在11项模拟日常生活活动中，手部肌肉疲劳是否会损害精细运动表现，通过比较疲劳前后任务得分和完成时间。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that hand muscle fatigue alone may be sufficient to impair fine motor performance in healthy adults. When assessing hand dysfunction in patients, consider muscle fatigue as a potential confounding factor.
items.limitation: 本研究的局限在于仅纳入健康成年男性和女性，结果可能无法直接推广到有手部病理状况的患者群体。
items.limitationEn: The study is limited by its inclusion of only healthy male and female adults, meaning results may not directly generalize to patient populations with hand pathologies.

items.title: Applying the International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health to Classify Upper Limb Outcome Measures in Stroke Rehabilitation: A Construct-Driven Perspective.
items.summary: This perspective piece applies the International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health (ICF) to clarify the classification of upper limb outcome measures in stroke rehabilitation, emphasizing that scoring criteria, not just item content, should define what is being assessed.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提醒你在卒中上肢康复中，评估工具的分类应更侧重其评分标准而非表面任务内容。这有助于避免混淆功能障碍与活动受限的恢复，确保康复计划的精准性。
items.titleZh: 应用国际功能、残疾和健康分类（ICF）对卒中康复上肢结局测量工具进行分类：一个概念驱动的视角
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评文章运用国际功能、残疾和健康分类（ICF）框架，阐明了卒中康复中上肢结局测量工具的分类方式，强调应以评分标准而非仅仅项目内容来界定评估重点，以避免混淆功能障碍与活动受限。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reminds you that in stroke upper limb rehabilitation, the classification of assessment tools should prioritize their scoring criteria over superficial task content. This helps avoid confusing impairment recovery with activity limitation, ensuring precise rehabilitation planning.
items.limitation: 本述评为概念性分析，未提供实证数据支持其分类框架。
items.limitationEn: This commentary is a conceptual analysis and does not provide empirical data to support its classification framework.

items.title: Experiences of frontline physiotherapists during the COVID-19 pandemic at two tertiary hospitals in Southern Malawi: A phenomenological qualitative study
items.summary: A phenomenological qualitative study explored the experiences of 11 frontline physiotherapists in two tertiary hospitals in Southern Malawi during the COVID-19 pandemic, aiming to inform future workforce support plans.
items.curatedReason: 这次疫情让我们看到，像马拉维这样资源有限地区的 11 位前线物理治疗师，在疫情期间面临巨大压力，急需完善的心理支持和物资保障。别再把这些定性研究当成可有可无的，它们能直接告诉我们如何改进未来的紧急响应计划。
items.titleZh: COVID-19 疫情期间马拉维南部两家三级医院前线物理治疗师的经历：一项现象学定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项现象学定性研究调查了 COVID-19 疫情期间马拉维南部两家三级医院的 11 名前线物理治疗师的经历，旨在为未来的劳动力支持计划提供信息。
items.curatedReasonEn: The pandemic highlighted that 11 frontline physiotherapists in resource-limited settings like Malawi faced immense pressure and urgently needed better psychological support and material resources. Stop dismissing these qualitative studies; they directly inform how we can improve future emergency response plans.
items.limitation: 这是一项定性研究，仅在马拉维的两个医院采访了 11 名物理治疗师，结果不具有普遍性，但提供了深入的个体经验。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study interviewed only 11 physiotherapists in two Malawian hospitals, so the findings are not generalizable but offer in-depth individual experiences.

items.title: APTA, Provider and Patient Groups Push Major Reforms to Prior Authorization

items.summaryZh: APTA 与其他医疗提供者和患者团体联合，推动对预授权流程进行重大改革。

items.title: Coalition Pushes Congress to Repeal MPPR as Part of Medicare Payment Reform

items.curatedReasonEn: The repeal of Medicare MPPR is a long-standing demand of the PT industry. If successful, this reform will directly increase your Medicare service reimbursement rates and improve clinic revenue.

items.summaryZh: APTA 反对教育部限制联邦学生贷款的最终规则，指出其可能对未来的物理治疗学生造成负面影响。

items.summaryZh: 物理治疗专业的新版道德准则已发布，为从业者提供了最新的伦理指导。

items.title: American College of Sports Medicine Position Stand. Resistance Training Prescription for Muscle Function, Hypertrophy, and Physical Performance in Healthy Adults: An Overview of Reviews
items.summary: The American College of Sports Medicine's position stand provides an overview of reviews on resistance training prescription for muscle function, hypertrophy, and physical performance in healthy adults.

items.titleZh: 美国运动医学学会立场声明：健康成年人肌肉功能、肥大和体能表现的力量训练处方综述
items.summaryZh: 美国运动医学学会的立场声明，概述了健康成年人肌肉功能、肥大和体能表现的力量训练处方综述。
items.curatedReasonEn: This ACSM position stand, as the latest overview of resistance training prescription for healthy adults, offers direct guidance for clinical practice in sports rehabilitation and performance training. You can use the summarized evidence to optimize your patients' training programs.

items.titleZh: 女性运动员损伤预防（FAIR）实用建议：2025 年国际奥委会（IOC）瑞士洛桑共识会议
items.summaryZh: 2025 年在瑞士洛桑举行的国际奥委会（IOC）共识会议发布了女性运动员损伤预防（FAIR）的实用建议。
items.curatedReasonEn: The IOC consensus meeting's recommendations for female athlete injury prevention provide crucial guidance for developing female sports rehabilitation and performance training programs. Incorporate them into your assessments and interventions.

items.titleZh: Medicare Part B 基础教育：会员免费新课程上线
items.summaryZh: APTA 为会员提供关于 Medicare Part B 基础知识的免费新课程，涵盖该计划的关键方面。
items.curatedReasonEn: New PTs or colleagues with questions about Medicare Part B reimbursement details should consider this free APTA course. It will help you more accurately understand and navigate Medicare regulations and processes.

items.title: Understanding Anterior Cruciate Ligament Adaptation: Structural, Mechanical, and Healing Considerations
items.summary: This review provides a comprehensive understanding of anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) adaptation, focusing on its structural, mechanical, and healing considerations relevant to sports medicine.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述深入探讨了前交叉韧带（ACL）的结构、力学和愈合适应。它能帮助你更好地理解 ACL 损伤后的生物力学和康复机制，优化你的训练策略。
items.titleZh: 理解前交叉韧带适应性：结构、力学和愈合考量
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述全面阐述了前交叉韧带（ACL）的适应性，侧重于其在运动医学中相关的结构、力学和愈合考量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review systematically synthesizes the structural, mechanical, and healing adaptation mechanisms of the ACL, offering a comprehensive understanding from a sports medicine perspective. It can deepen your understanding of post-ACL injury biomechanical changes, allowing for more precise rehabilitation program design and optimized patient training strategies.
items.limitation: 本研究为综述，未提供新的原始数据，其结论基于现有文献的解释和整合。
items.limitationEn: This is a review, not providing new original data, and its conclusions are based on the interpretation and integration of existing literature.

items.title: Beyond the incision: Does release extent matter in congenital muscular torticollis? A systematic review
items.summary: A systematic review investigates whether the extent of surgical release matters in congenital muscular torticollis, analyzing its impact beyond the incision.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述探讨了先天性肌性斜颈手术松解范围的重要性。虽然是外科内容，但了解不同松解程度对手术预后的影响，有助于你更好地与外科医生协作，并设计术后康复方案。
items.titleZh: 超越切口：先天性肌性斜颈中松解范围是否重要？一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述探讨了先天性肌性斜颈中手术松解范围是否重要，分析了其在切口之外的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review delves into the importance of the extent of surgical release in congenital muscular torticollis. While a surgical topic, understanding how different degrees of release impact postoperative outcomes can help you better collaborate with surgical teams and adjust postoperative rehabilitation protocols for optimal results.
items.limitation: 本研究为系统综述，其结论的强度取决于纳入研究的质量和异质性。
items.limitationEn: This is a systematic review, and the strength of its conclusions depends on the quality and heterogeneity of the included studies.

items.title: the Exercise Harms Reporting Method (ExHaRM) - BMJ Open
items.summary: This article proposes the Exercise Harms Reporting Method (ExHaRM), offering practical suggestions for improving harms reporting in exercise oncology to enhance transparency and patient safety.
items.curatedReason: 这篇论文提出了《运动损伤报告方法》（ExHaRM），旨在改善肿瘤运动学中的不良事件报告。在你为肿瘤患者设计运动方案时，这提供了一个更规范的伤害报告框架。
items.titleZh: 运动损伤报告方法（ExHaRM）
items.summaryZh: 本文提出了运动损伤报告方法（ExHaRM），为改善肿瘤运动学中的损伤报告提供了实用建议，以提高透明度和患者安全。
items.curatedReasonEn: This paper introduces the Exercise Harms Reporting Method (ExHaRM), aiming to improve adverse event reporting in exercise oncology. When designing exercise programs for oncology patients, this provides a more standardized framework for harm reporting.
items.limitation: 该文章提出了方法学建议，但并未提供该方法在实际应用中的有效性或影响的实证数据。
items.limitationEn: This article proposes methodological suggestions but does not provide empirical data on the effectiveness or impact of the method in practical application.

items.title: Comparative effectiveness of azithromycin versus roflumilast in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease: emulated target trial
items.summary: An emulated target trial compared the comparative effectiveness of azithromycin versus roflumilast in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, aiming to reduce exacerbations and improve patient outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这篇论文比较了两种药物（阿奇霉素与罗氟司特）在慢阻肺（COPD）患者中的有效性。虽然不直接涉及物理治疗干预，但了解药物治疗进展有助于你更好地理解患者的整体管理方案。
items.titleZh: 阿奇霉素与罗氟司特在慢性阻塞性肺病患者中的比较有效性：模拟目标试验
items.summaryZh: 一项模拟目标试验比较了阿奇霉素与罗氟司特在慢性阻塞性肺病患者中的比较有效性，旨在减少急性加重并改善患者结局。
items.curatedReasonEn: This paper compares the effectiveness of two drugs (azithromycin versus roflumilast) in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). While not directly involving physical therapy interventions, understanding drug treatment advancements can help you better grasp patients' overall management plans.
items.limitation: 本研究比较的是药物有效性，不涉及物理治疗干预。
items.limitationEn: This study compares drug effectiveness and does not involve physical therapy interventions.

items.title: Association Between Danish Guideline Treatments for Breast Cancer and Physiotherapy-Relevant Late Effects: A Nationwide Cohort Study.
items.summary: A nationwide cohort study from Denmark found associations between specific guideline treatments for breast cancer and the risk of physiotherapy-relevant late effects, including shoulder impairment, lymphedema, and fatigue, 3-7 years postoperatively.
items.curatedReason: 这份丹麦全国性队列研究提示，特定的乳腺癌治疗方案与术后3-7年出现肩部功能障碍、淋巴水肿和疲劳等物理治疗相关晚期并发症的风险有关。这意味着在术后早期，你应密切关注那些接受了高风险治疗方案的患者，并考虑预防性干预。
items.titleZh: 丹麦乳腺癌指南治疗方案与物理治疗相关晚期并发症的关联：一项全国性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项丹麦全国性队列研究评估了乳腺癌指南治疗方案与术后 3-7 年物理治疗相关晚期并发症（如肩部功能障碍、淋巴水肿、疲劳）风险的关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Danish nationwide cohort study suggests specific breast cancer treatments are associated with a higher risk of late effects like shoulder impairment, lymphedema, and fatigue 3-7 years postoperatively. This implies you should closely monitor patients receiving these higher-risk treatments in the early post-op phase and consider proactive interventions.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性队列研究，且结局为患者自报，存在潜在混杂因素和回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective cohort study used patient self-reported outcomes, introducing potential confounders and recall bias.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Sacroiliac Joint Dysfunction and Associated Disability in the Immediate Postpartum Period: A Cross-Sectional Analysis for Clinical Screening and Rehabilitation
items.summary: A descriptive cross-sectional study in Sialkot, Pakistan, involving 300 postpartum women aged 20-40 years, found a high prevalence of sacroiliac joint pain and associated disability in the immediate postpartum period.
items.curatedReason: 本项横断面研究揭示了产后骶髂关节疼痛在巴基斯坦锡亚尔科特地区发病率较高，且与功能障碍存在关联。但鉴于其观察性设计，在指导临床实践时，仍需更高级别的证据来支持干预措施的有效性。
items.titleZh: 产后即刻骶髂关节功能障碍与相关残疾：一项临床筛查与康复的横断面分析
items.summaryZh: 一项在巴基斯坦锡亚尔科特对 300 名 20-40 岁产后女性进行的横断面研究发现，产后即刻骶髂关节疼痛患病率较高，且与功能障碍相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cross-sectional study reveals a high prevalence of postpartum sacroiliac joint pain and its association with disability in Sialkot, Pakistan. However, given its observational design, higher-level evidence is still needed to support the effectiveness of interventions in guiding clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法推断因果关系，且数据来自单一地区，外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This study's cross-sectional design prevents causal inference, and its single-region data limits generalizability.

items.title: Physical and mental health-related quality of life outcomes of non-pharmacological interventions in early multiple sclerosis: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis found effects of non-pharmacological interventions on physical and mental health-related quality of life among adults with early diagnosed multiple sclerosis, with findings pooled using standardized mean differences.
items.curatedReason: 非药物干预对早期多发性硬化症（MS）患者的身心健康相关生活质量有积极影响。你可以根据这些高级别证据，更自信地将非药物策略纳入早期MS患者的治疗计划中。
items.titleZh: 早期多发性硬化症非药物干预对身心健康相关生活质量结局的影响：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析发现，非药物干预对早期多发性硬化症成人身心健康相关生活质量具有影响，结果采用标准化均数差进行汇总。
items.curatedReasonEn: Non-pharmacological interventions positively impact physical and mental health-related quality of life in adults with early multiple sclerosis (MS). You can confidently integrate non-pharmacological strategies into early MS patient care plans, supported by this high-level evidence.
items.limitation: 研究未报告效应量和异质性，无法全面评估干预效果的强度和一致性。
items.limitationEn: The study did not report effect sizes and heterogeneity, preventing a comprehensive evaluation of the strength and consistency of intervention effects.

items.title: Exercise Interventions for Older Adults with Alzheimer's Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 142 articles explored the effectiveness of physical exercise on cognitive function and optimal dosage in older adults with Alzheimer's disease, drawing from Embase, PsycInfo, and Ovid Medline databases.
items.curatedReason: 体育锻炼能有效改善阿尔茨海默病（AD）老年人的认知功能，但最佳剂量尚需个体化考量。你可以将运动疗法作为AD管理的重要组成部分，但需结合患者具体情况调整方案。
items.titleZh: 运动干预对阿尔茨海默病老年人的影响：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对142篇文章的系统综述和荟萃分析，探讨了运动对阿尔茨海默病老年人认知功能的有效性和最佳剂量，数据来源于Embase、PsycInfo和Ovid Medline数据库。
items.curatedReasonEn: Physical exercise effectively improves cognitive function in older adults with Alzheimer's disease (AD), though optimal dosage requires individualized consideration. You can integrate exercise therapy as a key component of AD management, but tailor protocols to each patient's specific needs.
items.limitation: 研究未明确报告具体效应量和异质性，可能影响对干预效果强度和一致性的全面理解。
items.limitationEn: The study did not explicitly report specific effect sizes and heterogeneity, which may limit a comprehensive understanding of the strength and consistency of intervention effects.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Clinically interpretable prediction models of stroke functional outcomes: A national cohort study of adults in inpatient rehabilitation facilities in the US.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study (n=43,745) developed clinically interpretable prediction models for self-care and mobility function at discharge from US inpatient rehabilitation facilities for adults with stroke, using only Inpatient Rehabilitation Facility Patient Assessment Instrument (IRF-PAI) variables.
items.curatedReason: 这项全国性队列研究开发了卒中患者住院康复出院时功能结局的临床预测模型。它基于美国医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心（CMS）强制要求的数据，能为您评估患者出院自理和活动能力提供实用工具。
items.titleZh: 卒中功能结局的临床可解释预测模型：美国住院康复机构成人全国队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究（n=43,745）利用美国住院康复机构患者评估工具（IRF-PAI）变量，为美国卒中成人住院康复出院时的自理和活动功能开发了临床可解释的预测模型。
items.curatedReasonEn: This national cohort study developed clinically interpretable prediction models for stroke functional outcomes at discharge from inpatient rehabilitation. Based on data mandated by CMS, it provides a practical tool for you to assess patients' self-care and mobility at discharge.
items.limitation: 这是一个回顾性队列研究，结果可能受数据报告完整性和准确性的限制，且模型在其他人群或医疗系统中的外推性需验证。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective cohort study, and results may be limited by the completeness and accuracy of data reporting; generalizability of the model to other populations or healthcare systems needs validation.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Effect of kinesiology taping on limb oedema in patients with severe hyper-dependency using shear-wave elastography: a randomized clinical trial.
items.summary: A randomized clinical trial (n=50) demonstrated that kinesiology taping at 25% tension significantly reduced the elastic coefficient of the dermis in patients with limb oedema compared to 0% tension taping by day 9, with effects sustained to day 16.
items.curatedReason: 肌内效贴布（25%张力）能显著降低严重肢体水肿患者真皮的弹性系数，效果持续至第 16 天。在处理这类水肿时，可以考虑使用 25% 张力的肌内效贴布作为有效干预手段。
items.titleZh: 肌内效贴布对重度依赖性肢体水肿患者的影响：一项随机临床试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机临床试验（n=50）表明，与0%张力贴布相比，25%张力肌内效贴布在第9天显著降低了肢体水肿患者真皮的弹性系数，效果持续至第16天。
items.curatedReasonEn: Kinesiology taping at 25% tension significantly reduces the elastic coefficient of the dermis in patients with severe limb oedema, with effects sustained up to day 16. When managing such oedema, consider using kinesiology taping at 25% tension as an effective intervention.
items.limitation: 试验随访期较短（16天），长期效果和机制需进一步研究。
items.limitationEn: The trial's follow-up period was relatively short (16 days), and long-term effects and mechanisms require further investigation.

items.title: Virtual reality-assisted rehabilitation after arthroscopic rotator cuff repair for small-to-medium supraspinatus tears: a prospective assessor-blinded randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A prospective assessor-blinded randomized controlled trial examined virtual reality-assisted rehabilitation after arthroscopic rotator cuff repair for small-to-medium supraspinatus tears, noting VR's potential to standardize tasks and provide feedback.
items.curatedReason: 对于小型至中型冈上肌撕裂关节镜肩袖修复术后的康复，VR 辅助康复是一种可行方案。你可以考虑将其引入临床，因为它在标准化任务和即时反馈方面表现良好，且有 RCT 证据支持。
items.titleZh: 虚拟现实辅助康复对小型至中型冈上肌撕裂关节镜肩袖修复术后的影响：一项前瞻性评估者盲法随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性评估者盲法随机对照试验研究了虚拟现实辅助康复对小型至中型冈上肌撕裂关节镜肩袖修复术后的影响，指出VR在标准化任务和提供反馈方面的潜力。
items.curatedReasonEn: For rehabilitation after arthroscopic rotator cuff repair of small-to-medium supraspinatus tears, VR-assisted rehabilitation is a viable option. You can consider introducing it into your clinic, as it performs well in standardizing tasks and providing immediate feedback, with RCT evidence to back it up.
items.limitation: 研究仅限于小型至中型冈上肌撕裂，结果对外科修复类型和损伤程度的普遍性可能有限。
items.limitationEn: The study was limited to small-to-medium supraspinatus tears, so the generalizability of the results to other surgical repair types and injury severities may be limited.

items.title: Slow eccentric- versus concentric-focused resistance training in middle-aged and older women with knee osteoarthritis: A randomized trial
items.summary: A randomized trial compared the short-term effects of slow eccentric-only resistance training (SET) and slow concentric-only resistance training (SCT) on pain and physical function in middle-aged and older women with knee osteoarthritis.
items.curatedReason: 治疗膝骨关节炎中老年女性的疼痛和功能障碍，慢速离心训练和慢速向心训练都有效。这项 RCT 提示，在短期效果上，两者没有显著差异，选择哪种方式取决于患者的依从性和设备可及性。
items.titleZh: 慢速离心训练与向心训练对膝骨关节炎中老年女性的影响：一项随机试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机试验比较了慢速离心阻力训练（SET）和慢速向心阻力训练（SCT）对膝骨关节炎中老年女性疼痛和身体功能的短期效果。
items.curatedReasonEn: Both slow eccentric and slow concentric resistance training are effective for treating pain and functional limitations in middle-aged and older women with knee osteoarthritis. This RCT suggests there's no significant short-term difference between them, so your choice might depend on patient adherence and equipment availability.
items.limitation: 研究仅评估了短期效果，长期疗效和依从性尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: The study only assessed short-term effects, and long-term efficacy and adherence remain unclear.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Nordic walking and sprinting enhance lower limb vertical power in Parkinson’s: an exploratory study
items.summary: An exploratory study found that Nordic walking and sprinting enhanced lower limb vertical power, specifically jump height and peak power, in individuals with Parkinson's disease.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性研究发现北欧式行走和冲刺训练能增强帕金森病（PD）患者的下肢垂直力量。它为您在PD患者康复中引入这类高强度运动提供了初步证据，有助于改善患者的运动功能。
items.titleZh: 北欧式行走和冲刺训练增强帕金森病患者下肢垂直力量：一项探索性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项探索性研究发现，北欧式行走和冲刺训练能增强帕金森病患者的下肢垂直力量，特别是跳跃高度和峰值力量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory study found that Nordic walking and sprinting enhance lower limb vertical power in Parkinson's disease (PD) patients. It provides preliminary evidence for introducing such high-intensity exercises into PD rehabilitation, helping to improve patients' motor function.
items.limitation: 这是一项探索性研究，样本量较小，结论需要更大规模的随机对照试验验证。
items.limitationEn: This was an exploratory study with a small sample size, and the conclusions require validation through larger randomized controlled trials.

items.title: Reliability and construct validity of three movement-evoked pain methods in individuals with knee osteoarthritis.
items.summary: This study evaluated the reliability and construct validity of three movement-evoked pain (MEP) calculation methods in 111 individuals with knee osteoarthritis, finding acceptable test-retest reliability and construct validity for all methods.
items.curatedReason: 三种运动诱发疼痛测量方法在膝骨关节炎患者中是可靠且有效的。在临床评估中，你可以放心使用这些方法，它们能提供准确的疼痛反馈。
items.titleZh: 膝骨关节炎患者运动诱发疼痛三种测量方法的信度和结构效度
items.summaryZh: 这项研究评估了111名膝骨关节炎患者三种运动诱发疼痛（MEP）计算方法的信度和结构效度，发现所有方法都具有可接受的重测信度和结构效度。
items.curatedReasonEn: Three movement-evoked pain measurement methods for knee osteoarthritis are reliable and valid. You can confidently use these methods in clinical assessments, as they provide accurate pain feedback.
items.limitation: 这是一项二次分析，样本量适中，研究人群为巴西单中心患者，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: This was a secondary analysis with a moderate sample size, and the study population from a single center in Brazil may limit generalizability.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Feasibility and acceptability of the breakfast group intervention BISTRo for stroke survivors in acute rehabilitation.
items.summary: A multisite mixed-methods feasibility study with 16 stroke survivors and 53 multidisciplinary staff examined the feasibility and acceptability of the BISTRo breakfast group intervention delivered in acute stroke rehabilitation in the UK, finding it feasible and acceptable.
items.curatedReason: 在英国急性卒中康复环境中，BISTRo 早餐小组干预是可行且可接受的。你可以考虑在你的临床实践中引入类似的集体用餐和社交活动，以促进患者的积极参与和多学科协作。
items.titleZh: 急性康复期卒中幸存者早餐组干预 BISTRo 的可行性和可接受性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对16名卒中幸存者和53名多学科工作人员的多中心混合方法可行性研究，评估了在英国急性卒中康复服务中实施早餐组干预 BISTRo 的可行性和可接受性，发现该干预措施是可行的且可接受。
items.curatedReasonEn: The BISTRo breakfast group intervention is feasible and acceptable in acute stroke rehabilitation in the UK. You might consider introducing similar communal dining and social activities in your practice to foster patient engagement and multidisciplinary collaboration.
items.limitation: 这是一个小样本的多中心可行性研究，结果可能不完全适用于所有临床环境，需更大规模验证。
items.limitationEn: This was a small-sample, multisite feasibility study, and the results may not be fully applicable to all clinical settings; larger-scale validation is needed.

items.title: Methodological characteristics of perturbation-based balance training in healthy older adults: A scoping review.
items.summary: This scoping review systematically mapped and characterized the methodological features of mechanically induced perturbation-based balance training interventions in healthy older adults, highlighting methodological variability that limits synthesis and clinical translation.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述系统地绘制并描述了健康老年人扰动训练（PBT）的现有方法学特征。它指出了PBT在防跌倒方面的潜力，但强调了方法学差异限制了临床转化，提示您在应用时需关注其具体实施细节。
items.titleZh: 健康老年人扰动平衡训练的方法学特征：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 这项范围综述系统地绘制并描述了健康老年人机械诱导扰动平衡训练干预的方法学特征，强调了限制综合和临床转化的方法学变异性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review systematically mapped and characterized the methodological features of perturbation-based balance training (PBT) in healthy older adults. It highlights PBT's potential for fall prevention but emphasizes that methodological variability limits clinical translation, suggesting you pay attention to specific implementation details when applying it.
items.limitation: 范围综述侧重于方法学特征，未深入评估PBT的临床疗效或安全性。

items.curatedReasonEn: Systemic inflammation is a key mediator of exercise benefits in chronic low back pain. Understanding this mechanism can help you design more precise exercise protocols to maximize anti-inflammatory and analgesic effects.

items.title: "It's really, really just exercise I put my faith in now": Patients' perspectives on rotator cuff tendinopathy management: A qualitative study.

items.curatedReason: 生理镜像活动与皮层肌肉相干性在手指灵巧任务中与年龄相关。这提示我们在康复策略中可能需要针对老年人不同的神经生理机制进行调整，以优化运动学习和功能恢复。
items.titleZh: 健康年轻和老年人手指灵巧任务中生理镜像活动与皮层肌肉相干性之间的关系
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究调查了31名年轻右撇子成人和24名老年右撇子成人在左手手指灵巧任务中，生理镜像活动与皮层肌肉相干性之间的关系。
items.curatedReasonEn: Physiological mirror activity and corticomuscular coherence during finger dexterity tasks are age-related. This suggests that rehabilitation strategies for older adults may need to be adjusted to their distinct neurophysiological mechanisms to optimize motor learning and functional recovery.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法揭示生理镜像活动与皮层肌肉相干性之间随时间的动态变化或因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This was a cross-sectional study, which cannot reveal dynamic changes over time or causal relationships between physiological mirror activity and corticomuscular coherence.

items.title: Longitudinal changes in serum taurine following acute traumatic spinal cord injury: a prospective pilot study of diagnostic performance and functional recovery
items.summary: A prospective pilot study investigated the longitudinal changes in serum taurine following acute traumatic spinal cord injury (SCI) and its association with diagnostic performance and functional recovery.
items.curatedReason: 急性创伤性脊髓损伤（SCI）后血清牛磺酸水平的变化，可能与功能恢复存在关联，但目前只是初步观察研究。这个生物标志物距离临床应用还很远，切勿过早解读或应用于患者评估。
items.titleZh: 急性创伤性脊髓损伤后血清牛磺酸的纵向变化：一项诊断性能和功能恢复的前瞻性初步研究
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性初步研究调查了急性创伤性脊髓损伤（SCI）后血清牛磺酸的纵向变化及其与诊断性能和功能恢复的关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: Changes in serum taurine levels after acute traumatic spinal cord injury (SCI) might be associated with functional recovery, but this is merely a preliminary observational study. This biomarker is far from clinical application; do not prematurely interpret or apply it to patient assessments.
items.limitation: 这是一项初步研究，需要更大规模和更长的随访期来验证结果。
items.limitationEn: This was a pilot study, and larger scale with longer follow-up is needed to validate the results.

items.title: Bidirectional association between injuries and mental health symptoms among elite athletes: a systematic review
items.summary: A systematic review of 25 studies found a bidirectional association between musculoskeletal injuries and mental health symptoms among elite athletes, indicating that mental health symptoms can precede injury, and injury can lead to subsequent mental health symptoms.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述明确了精英运动员伤病与心理健康症状之间的双向关联。你需要认识到，心理健康问题可能导致受伤，而受伤反过来也会影响心理健康，因此在康复和预防中，务必同时评估和管理这两个方面。
items.titleZh: 精英运动员伤病与心理健康症状之间的双向关联：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 25 项研究的系统综述发现，精英运动员的肌肉骨骼损伤与心理健康症状之间存在双向关联，表明心理健康症状可能先于受伤，而受伤也可能导致随后的心理健康症状。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review clarifies the bidirectional association between injuries and mental health symptoms in elite athletes. You need to recognize that mental health issues can lead to injuries, and injuries, in turn, can affect mental health, making it crucial to assess and manage both aspects concurrently in rehabilitation and prevention.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的方法学异质性较高，且多数研究为观察性，无法完全确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: The included studies had high methodological heterogeneity, and most were observational, thus not fully establishing causality.

items.title: Depressive symptoms in high-performance athletes and non-athletes: a comparative meta-analysis update
items.summary: An updated comparative meta-analysis of 10 studies found no significant difference in the prevalence of mild or more severe depressive symptoms between high-performance athletes and non-athletes.
items.curatedReason: 这项更新的荟萃分析发现，与非运动员相比，高水平运动员出现轻度或更严重抑郁症状的风险并无显著差异。这挑战了“运动员心理更健康”的普遍观念，提示你在实践中应平等关注运动员的心理健康。
items.titleZh: 高水平运动员与非运动员抑郁症状的比较荟萃分析更新
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖 10 项研究的比较荟萃分析更新发现，高水平运动员与非运动员之间，轻度或更严重抑郁症状的患病率没有显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This updated meta-analysis finds no significant difference in the risk of mild or severe depressive symptoms between high-performance athletes and non-athletes. This challenges the common perception of athletes being mentally healthier, prompting you to equally prioritize athletes' mental health in practice.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的数量有限（10 项），且存在方法学异质性，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The limited number of included studies (10) and methodological heterogeneity may affect the generalizability of the results.

items.title: International Olympic Committee Sport Mental Health Assessment Tool 2 (IOC SMHAT2): development, content validity and feasibility
items.summary: The International Olympic Committee (IOC) developed and validated the IOC Sport Mental Health Assessment Tool 2 (IOC SMHAT2) for sports medicine physicians, building on user feedback and misclassification analysis of the previous version.
items.curatedReason: 国际奥委会开发并验证了新的运动心理健康评估工具（IOC SMHAT2），为体育医学医师和其他运动医学专业人员提供了更全面、实用的心理健康筛查手段。
items.titleZh: 国际奥委会运动心理健康评估工具 2 (IOC SMHAT2)：开发、内容效度和可行性
items.summaryZh: 国际奥委会（IOC）基于用户反馈和对前一版本误分类分析，开发并验证了运动心理健康评估工具 2 (IOC SMHAT2)，供体育医学医师使用。
items.curatedReasonEn: The IOC has developed and validated a new Sport Mental Health Assessment Tool (IOC SMHAT2), offering sports medicine physicians and other professionals a more comprehensive and practical mental health screening method.

items.title: Substance use patterns in elite athletes: a scoping review of alcohol, performance-enhancing drugs and other psychoactive substances
items.summary: A scoping review systematically mapped and synthesized scientific literature on substance use patterns among elite athletes, encompassing recreational substances, performance-enhancing drugs (PEDs), and polysubstance use from inception to March 2025.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围审查系统地描绘了精英运动员的物质使用模式，包括休闲物质、增强表现药物和多重物质使用，为你了解这些运动员群体中的风险因素提供了综合视图。
items.titleZh: 精英运动员物质使用模式：酒精、增强表现药物和其他精神活性物质的范围审查
items.summaryZh: 一项范围审查系统地描绘并综合了截至 2025 年 3 月的精英运动员物质使用模式科学文献，涵盖休闲物质、增强表现药物（PEDs）和多重物质使用。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review systematically maps substance use patterns among elite athletes, including recreational substances, performance-enhancing drugs, and polysubstance use, offering a comprehensive view of risk factors in these athlete populations.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围审查，仅描绘了现有文献，并未进行质量评估或数据合成以得出干预效果的结论。
items.limitationEn: This is a scoping review that only maps existing literature and does not include quality assessment or data synthesis to draw conclusions on intervention effectiveness.

items.title: Post-traumatic stress disorder and related disorders in elite athletes: a narrative review
items.summary: This narrative review examines post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) and related disorders in elite athletes, highlighting their potential for higher rates due to disproportionate exposure to traumas and stressors and the importance of early detection.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述提醒你，精英运动员因其经历的创伤和应激源，可能面临较高的创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）及其相关疾病风险。关注其复杂症状表现和应对策略，有助于早期识别和干预。
items.titleZh: 精英运动员的创伤后应激障碍及相关疾病：一项叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述审视了精英运动员的创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）及相关疾病，强调他们因遭受过多的创伤和应激源而可能面临更高的患病率，并指出早期检测的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review reminds you that elite athletes may face a higher risk of PTSD and related disorders due to their exposure to traumas and stressors. Paying attention to their complex symptom presentations and coping strategies can aid early identification and intervention.
items.limitation: 本研究为叙述性综述，可能存在选择偏倚，且未对证据质量进行系统评估。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, which may have selection bias and did not systematically assess evidence quality.

items.title: The International Olympic Committee advances a second Consensus Statement on Mental Health in Elite Athletes
items.summary: The International Olympic Committee (IOC) has released its second Consensus Statement on Mental Health in Elite Athletes, building on the 2019 statement by catalysing initiatives for mental health integration across the Olympic movement.
items.curatedReason: 这份国际奥委会声明再次强调了精英运动员心理健康的重要性，但其关注的心理健康整合策略，对所有运动人群的康复与表现训练都有借鉴意义。别再把心理健康和身体健康割裂开了。
items.titleZh: 国际奥委会发布第二份《精英运动员心理健康共识声明》
items.summaryZh: 国际奥委会（IOC）发布了第二份《精英运动员心理健康共识声明》，该声明在 2019 年版本的基础上，通过推动各项举措，进一步将心理健康整合到奥林匹克运动中。
items.curatedReasonEn: This IOC statement reinforces the critical importance of mental health in elite athletes, and its integrated mental health strategies are equally relevant for rehabilitation and performance training in all athletic populations. Stop treating mental and physical health as separate entities.

items.title: Refining mental health literacy strategies in elite sport
items.summary: This article discusses refining mental health literacy strategies in elite sport to promote early identification, effective management, and timely help-seeking for mental health symptoms and disorders among athletes.
items.curatedReason: 这份评论文章探讨了在精英体育中提升心理健康素养的重要性，指出了如何塑造对心理健康症状的识别、解读、讨论和应对方式，以促进运动员及时寻求帮助。
items.titleZh: 完善精英体育中的心理健康素养策略
items.summaryZh: 本文讨论了完善精英体育中的心理健康素养策略，以促进运动员心理健康症状和疾病的早期识别、有效管理和及时寻求帮助。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary explores the importance of improving mental health literacy in elite sports, outlining how to shape the recognition, interpretation, discussion, and response to mental health symptoms to promote timely help-seeking among athletes.

items.title: Integrating a lived experience workforce to support and enhance mental health and well-being in elite sport
items.summary: This commentary advocates for integrating a 'lived experience workforce' into elite sport mental health support to address athletes' reluctance to seek help due to stigma, low mental health literacy, and concerns about professional understanding.
items.curatedReason: 这项评论呼吁将有亲身经验的工作人员整合到精英体育的心理健康支持中，指出这可以帮助克服运动员寻求帮助时的障碍，如污名化和对专业人士缺乏理解的担忧。
items.titleZh: 整合亲身经验工作者以支持和提升精英体育中的心理健康
items.summaryZh: 这份评论提倡将“有亲身经验的工作者”整合到精英体育的心理健康支持中，以解决运动员因污名化、低心理健康素养以及对专业人士理解不足的担忧而 reluctance 寻求帮助的问题。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary calls for integrating individuals with lived experience into elite sport mental health support, noting this can help overcome athlete barriers to help-seeking, such as stigma and concerns about professionals' understanding.

items.title: Contextualising the IOC consensus statement on mental health in elite athletes for low- and middle-income countries
items.summary: This editorial discusses contextualizing the International Olympic Committee (IOC) consensus statement on mental health in elite athletes for low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), proposing adaptations for local implementation given understudied evidence gaps.
items.curatedReason: 这份社论强调了将国际奥委会《精英运动员心理健康共识声明》的建议，应用于中低收入国家时需要进行背景敏感的调整，提示你在不同文化和经济背景下，要考虑政策和实践的本地化。
items.titleZh: 国际奥委会精英运动员心理健康共识声明在中低收入国家的语境化应用
items.summaryZh: 这份社论讨论了如何在低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）背景下应用国际奥委会（IOC）精英运动员心理健康共识声明，并针对证据不足的领域，提出了本地化实施的调整建议。
items.curatedReasonEn: This editorial highlights the need for context-sensitive adaptation when applying the IOC Consensus Statement on Mental Health in Elite Athletes to low- and middle-income countries, reminding you to consider localization of policies and practices in diverse cultural and economic settings.

items.title: Youth sports and mental health in sub-Saharan Africa
items.summary: This editorial highlights challenges in applying the updated International Olympic Committee (IOC) consensus statement on mental health in elite athletes to youth sports in sub-Saharan Africa due to distinct social, economic, and healthcare contexts.
items.curatedReason: 这份社论指出，国际奥委会的精英运动员心理健康指南在撒哈拉以南非洲的青年体育中实施面临挑战，提醒你在实践中需考虑不同地区的社会、经济和医疗背景差异。
items.titleZh: 撒哈拉以南非洲的青年体育与心理健康
items.summaryZh: 这份社论强调，由于撒哈拉以南非洲独特的社会、经济和医疗背景，在当地青年体育中应用国际奥委会（IOC）最新修订的精英运动员心理健康共识声明面临挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: This editorial notes that implementing the IOC's elite athlete mental health guidelines in youth sports in Sub-Saharan Africa faces challenges, reminding you to consider social, economic, and healthcare context differences across regions in practice.

items.title: Research priorities for advancing mental health in elite sport: a companion to the IOC consensus statement on mental health in elite athletes
items.summary: This companion article to the IOC consensus statement outlines research priorities for advancing mental health in elite sport, noting a more than threefold increase in peer-reviewed publications on this topic since 2019.
items.curatedReason: 这份研究重点回顾了精英运动员心理健康领域的研究优先事项，揭示了该领域出版物数量的显著增长，为你的研究和临床实践提供了未来关注方向。
items.titleZh: 推动精英体育心理健康的研究优先事项：国际奥委会精英运动员心理健康共识声明的配套文章
items.summaryZh: 这篇国际奥委会共识声明的配套文章概述了推动精英体育心理健康的研究优先事项，指出自 2019 年以来，该主题的同行评审出版物数量增长了三倍多。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review highlights research priorities in elite athlete mental health, revealing a significant increase in publications, providing future directions for your research and clinical practice.

items.title: Mental health in elite athletes: International Olympic Committee consensus statement (2026)
items.summary: The updated International Olympic Committee consensus statement (2026) emphasizes that mental health symptoms and disorders are common in elite athletes, may be sport-related, and impact performance, recommending routine screening and monitoring.
items.curatedReason: 这份 IOC 共识声明强调精英运动员心理健康问题普遍且可能与运动相关，并推荐使用验证工具进行常规筛查和监测。它确认了心理健康在运动康复中的重要性，你在日常实践中应更关注运动员的心理状态并考虑恰当的转诊。
items.titleZh: 精英运动员心理健康：国际奥委会共识声明（2026）
items.summaryZh: 更新后的国际奥委会共识声明（2026）强调，精英运动员的心理健康症状和障碍普遍存在，可能与运动相关并影响表现，建议进行常规筛查和监测。
items.curatedReasonEn: This IOC consensus statement highlights the prevalence of mental health issues in elite athletes, their potential sport-related etiologies, and recommends routine screening and monitoring. It affirms the importance of mental health in sports rehabilitation, prompting you to pay closer attention to athletes' psychological states and consider appropriate referrals.

items.title: When algorithms don't care: physiotherapy and the post-professional turn.
items.summary: This paper analyzes how physiotherapy, traditionally resistant to restructuring forces, is entering a post-professional era marked by practitioner marginalization due to commodification, challenges to expertise, and digital disruption.
items.curatedReason: PT 行业正在进入一个“后专业化”时代，这可能导致专业人员被边缘化。你需要警惕商品化、专业知识受到挑战以及数字化颠覆带来的潜在冲击，并开始思考如何适应这些变化。
items.titleZh: 当算法不关心：物理治疗与后专业化转向
items.summaryZh: 本文分析了传统上抵制重组力量的物理治疗如何进入一个“后专业化”时代，其特点是由于商品化、专业知识面临挑战以及数字颠覆，从业者在护理协调和提供中的边缘化。
items.curatedReasonEn: The PT profession is entering a “post-professional” era, potentially leading to practitioner marginalization. You need to be aware of the impending impacts of commodification, challenges to expertise, and digital disruption, and begin strategizing how to adapt.

items.title: Cardiovascular and autonomic responses to transcutaneous spinal cord stimulation combined with activity-based therapy after chronic spinal cord injury: An exploratory study from the MACHINE trial
items.summary: An exploratory case series from a randomized trial involving 8 adults with chronic motor-complete spinal cord injury found that 12 weeks of body weight-supported treadmill training combined with transcutaneous spinal cord stimulation led to changes in cardiovascular and autonomic responses, including improvements in blood pressure regulation.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性脊髓损伤患者，经皮脊髓电刺激结合活动性疗法（如 BWSTT）可能影响心血管和自主神经反应。在临床实践中，您应关注这种组合干预在改善自主神经功能障碍方面的潜力，但需注意其仍处于探索阶段，数据来自小样本。
items.titleZh: 慢性脊髓损伤后经皮脊髓电刺激结合活动性疗法的心血管与自主神经反应：MACHINE 试验的探索性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 8 名慢性运动完全性脊髓损伤成人进行的探索性案例研究（来自 MACHINE 随机试验）发现，为期 12 周的体重支持跑台训练结合经皮脊髓电刺激，能改变心血管和自主神经反应，包括改善血压调节。
items.curatedReasonEn: For individuals with chronic spinal cord injury, transcutaneous spinal cord stimulation combined with activity-based therapy (like BWSTT) may influence cardiovascular and autonomic responses. In practice, you should be aware of this combination's potential to improve autonomic dysfunction, but note that it is still in an exploratory phase with small sample data.
items.limitation: 本研究是来自更大试验的探索性案例系列，样本量小（n=8），且未报告主要结局的效应量。
items.limitationEn: This study is an exploratory case series from a larger trial with a small sample size (n=8) and did not report effect sizes for primary outcomes.

items.title: Manifestations of Oral Muscle Mass, Tongue Strength, and Endurance in Patients with Stroke Across Varying Degrees of Swallowing Function: A Pilot Study.
items.summary: A pilot cross-sectional study of 41 stroke patients found varying oral muscle mass, elasticity, and tongue performance across different swallowing function levels (FOIS 1-3, 4-6, 7), assessed using ultrasonography and sonoelastography.
items.curatedReason: 这项纳入 41 名卒中患者的探索性研究提示，不同吞咽功能水平（FOIS 1-3, 4-6, 7）与口腔肌肉质量、弹性及舌功能表现存在关联。评估吞咽障碍时，应考虑将超声及超声弹性成像作为补充工具，以更精细地识别潜在的病理生理机制。
items.titleZh: 卒中患者不同吞咽功能水平下口腔肌肉质量、舌力量和耐力的表现：一项初步研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 41 名卒中患者进行的初步横断面研究发现，根据功能性口腔摄入量表（FOIS）分级，口腔肌肉质量、弹性以及舌功能表现（通过超声和声波弹性成像评估）在不同吞咽功能水平的患者之间存在差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot study with 41 stroke patients suggests a link between varying swallowing function levels (FOIS 1-3, 4-6, 7) and oral muscle mass, elasticity, and tongue performance. When assessing dysphagia, consider ultrasonography and sonoelastography as supplementary tools for a more refined identification of underlying pathophysiological mechanisms.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面小样本研究（n=41），难以建立因果关系，结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a small cross-sectional pilot study (n=41), which limits the ability to establish causality and generalizability of the findings.

items.title: From Injury to Inclusion: Evidence From the International Spinal Cord Injury Survey (InSCI).
items.summary: An evidence map of the International Spinal Cord Injury Community Survey (InSCI) identified 117 peer-reviewed publications by April 2026, with healthcare needs and epidemiology being the largest categories, indicating significant research contributions and remaining knowledge gaps.
items.curatedReason: InSCI 问卷的证据图谱让你对全球脊髓损伤（SCI）研究的广度、焦点和知识缺口有清晰认识。可利用它快速定位你感兴趣的 SCI 亚专业方向，避免重复工作。
items.titleZh: 从损伤到融合：国际脊髓损伤调查（InSCI）的证据
items.summaryZh: 国际脊髓损伤社区调查（InSCI）的证据图谱显示，截至 2026 年 4 月，已产生 117 篇同行评议论文，其中医疗需求和流行病学是最大的类别，表明其显著的研究贡献和尚存的知识缺口。
items.curatedReasonEn: This InSCI evidence map, covering 117 peer-reviewed publications by April 2026, highlights that research is heavily concentrated on healthcare needs and epidemiology. If you're involved in spinal cord injury (SCI) research, use this map to quickly grasp current foci and identify under-researched areas, streamlining your efforts.
items.limitation: 证据图谱本身是对现有文献的汇总分析，不提供新的临床干预效果证据。
items.limitationEn: The evidence map itself is a summary analysis of existing literature and does not provide new evidence on the effects of clinical interventions.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Integrated rehabilitation incorporating aquatic therapy following posterior cruciate ligament reconstruction: a case report.
items.summary: A case report of a 51-year-old woman showed that integrated rehabilitation incorporating aquatic therapy following PCL reconstruction helped facilitate early functional recovery and reduced joint loading.
items.curatedReason: PCL 重建术后水疗的证据仍然稀缺。本病例报告提示水疗在早期功能恢复中可能发挥作用，但别把它当成常规方案。
items.titleZh: 整合水疗的后交叉韧带重建术后康复：一例病例报告
items.summaryZh: 一例 51 岁女性的病例报告显示，后交叉韧带（PCL）重建术后整合水疗的康复方案有助于促进早期功能恢复并减轻关节负荷。
items.curatedReasonEn: Evidence for aquatic therapy after PCL reconstruction remains scarce. This case report suggests aquatic therapy may facilitate early functional recovery, but don't integrate it into routine protocols yet.
items.limitation: 本研究为单病例报告，证据等级低，结果外推性差。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report with a low level of evidence and limited generalizability.

items.title: Effects of opioid-free intraoperative anesthesia versus opioid-based anesthesia on postoperative immune function in elderly patients undergoing total knee arthroplasty: a single-center, prospective, randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A single-center, prospective, randomized controlled trial investigates the effects of opioid-free intraoperative anesthesia versus opioid-based anesthesia on postoperative immune function in elderly patients undergoing total knee arthroplasty.
items.curatedReason: 对于全膝关节置换术的老年患者，无阿片类麻醉可能带来术后免疫功能改善的益处。在考虑术后康复方案时，应将这种麻醉选择对患者恢复的影响纳入考量。
items.titleZh: 老年全膝关节置换术中无阿片类麻醉对术后免疫功能影响的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项单中心、前瞻性随机对照试验旨在比较老年全膝关节置换术中，无阿片类麻醉与阿片类麻醉对患者术后免疫功能的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: Opioid-free anesthesia in elderly patients undergoing total knee arthroplasty may offer benefits in postoperative immune function. You should consider the impact of this anesthetic choice on patient recovery when planning postoperative rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 研究仅关注术后免疫功能，未报告直接的临床康复结局。
items.limitationEn: The study focused solely on postoperative immune function, without reporting direct clinical rehabilitation outcomes.

items.title: Associations between patient quality of life and caregiver burden among older adults receiving comprehensive geriatric assessment via telemedicine: a cross-sectional study from Seha Virtual Hospital, Saudi Arabia
items.summary: A cross-sectional study from Saudi Arabia explores associations between patient quality of life and caregiver burden among older adults receiving comprehensive geriatric assessment via telemedicine.
items.curatedReason: 远程医疗模式下，老年患者的生活质量与照护者负担之间存在显著关联。作为物理治疗师，你在远程康复中不仅要关注患者本身，也应主动识别和支持照护者，因为他们的负担会直接影响患者的康复依从性和效果。
items.titleZh: 沙特阿拉伯远程医疗综合老年评估中老年患者生活质量与照护者负担的关联
items.summaryZh: 一项来自沙特阿拉伯Seha虚拟医院的横断面研究，探讨了通过远程医疗接受综合老年评估的老年患者生活质量与照护者负担之间的关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: In telemedicine, there's a significant link between older patients' quality of life and caregiver burden. As a PT, in telerehabilitation, you must not only focus on the patient but also proactively identify and support caregivers, as their burden directly impacts patient adherence and rehabilitation outcomes.
items.limitation: 横断面研究无法建立因果关系，且研究人群和背景局限于沙特阿拉伯的虚拟医院，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional study cannot establish causality, and its population and context are limited to a virtual hospital in Saudi Arabia, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Surgical approaches for screw fixation of calcaneal fractures: a systematic review
items.summary: A systematic review summarizes evidence on different screw configurations for internal fixation of calcaneal fractures, identifying relevant studies from major databases up to December 2025.
items.curatedReason: 这份系统综述虽然聚焦跟骨骨折的手术固定方式，但仍有助你理解不同螺钉配置如何影响术后负重和康复进展的生物力学考量。在制定康复计划时，应向外科医生确认具体的固定情况。
items.titleZh: 跟骨骨折螺钉固定手术入路的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述总结了跟骨骨折内固定治疗中不同螺钉配置的证据，旨在为外科医生选择最佳方案提供参考。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review evaluates different screw fixation configurations for calcaneal fractures. While it focuses on surgical techniques, it can help you understand the biomechanical basis for postoperative weight-bearing restrictions and rehabilitation progression.
items.limitation: 该综述主要关注外科手术的比较，未直接涉及康复干预的结局。
items.limitationEn: The review primarily focuses on comparing surgical approaches and does not directly address rehabilitation intervention outcomes.

items.title: Situational characteristics of lower limb muscle cramps in male semi-elite football players: a video-based descriptive case series
items.summary: A video-based descriptive case series investigates the situational characteristics of lower limb muscle cramps in male semi-elite football players.
items.curatedReason: 半精英足球运动员的下肢肌肉痉挛，往往有其特定的发生情境。在评估和制定预防策略时，你需要更细致地询问痉挛的具体诱因和发生环境，因为这些细节可能比通用方案更有效。
items.titleZh: 半精英男足运动员下肢肌肉痉挛情境特征的视频描述性病例系列研究
items.summaryZh: 这项基于视频的描述性病例系列研究调查了半精英男性足球运动员下肢肌肉痉挛的情境特征。
items.curatedReasonEn: Lower limb muscle cramps in semi-elite football players often have specific situational characteristics. When assessing and developing prevention strategies, you need to inquire more precisely about the specific triggers and contexts of cramps, as these details may be more effective than general approaches.
items.limitation: 描述性研究，样本量小且局限于半精英男性足球运动员，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a descriptive study with a small sample size, limited to semi-elite male football players, thus limiting generalizability.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Differential neuromuscular adaptations following multi-joint vs single-joint resistance exercise training
items.summary: This study combines ultrasound, EMG, and dynamometry to establish differences in neuromechanical adaptations following multi-joint (squat) versus single-joint resistance training programs of equal training volume in 24 participants.
items.curatedReason: 多关节与单关节抗阻训练对神经肌肉适应性确实存在差异。在为患者设计抗阻训练时，不要仅仅关注训练量，更要根据运动特异性来选择多关节或单关节训练，以优化力量发展和功能恢复。
items.titleZh: 多关节与单关节抗阻训练对神经肌肉适应性的差异影响
items.summaryZh: 这项研究结合超声、肌电图和测力学测量，旨在评估多关节（深蹲）与单关节抗阻训练在神经肌肉适应性上的差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Multi-joint and single-joint resistance training indeed lead to different neuromuscular adaptations. When designing resistance training for patients, don't just focus on training volume; instead, choose multi-joint or single-joint exercises based on movement specificity to optimize strength development and functional recovery.
items.limitation: 研究细节不详，无法评估样本量和具体干预方案的严谨性。
items.limitationEn: Study details are insufficient to assess the rigor of sample size and specific intervention protocols.

items.title: Arthroscopic-assisted uni-portal spinal surgery versus unilateral biportal endoscopy for lumbar degenerative diseases: a systematic review and meta-analysis of clinical outcomes and complications
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis compares the clinical outcomes and complications of arthroscopic-assisted uni-portal spinal surgery versus unilateral biportal endoscopy for lumbar degenerative diseases.
items.curatedReason: 这份系统综述比较了两种微创脊柱内镜手术（关节镜辅助单通道与单侧双通道）在腰椎退行性疾病中的临床效果和并发症。尽管是外科内容，但这些手术选择直接影响患者术后康复路径和PT介入时机。
items.titleZh: 关节镜辅助单通道与单侧双通道脊柱内镜手术治疗腰椎退行性疾病的系统综述和Meta分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和Meta分析比较了关节镜辅助单通道脊柱手术与单侧双通道内镜手术治疗腰椎退行性疾病的临床结局和并发症。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review compares two minimally invasive endoscopic spinal surgeries (arthroscopic-assisted uni-portal vs. unilateral biportal) for lumbar degenerative diseases in terms of clinical outcomes and complications. Although surgical, these choices directly impact patients' postoperative rehabilitation pathways and PT intervention timing.
items.limitation: 该综述聚焦外科手术方法的比较，未直接分析不同术式对康复结局的具体影响。
items.limitationEn: The review focuses on comparing surgical methods and does not directly analyze the specific impact of different techniques on rehabilitation outcomes.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - Ahpra appoints new head of its Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Strategy Unit
items.summary: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (Ahpra) has announced the appointment of a new head for its Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Strategy Unit.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构（Ahpra）任命了新的原住民和托雷斯海峡岛民健康战略部门负责人。虽然是行政任命，但此类举措可能预示着未来在文化安全医疗和多元化执业方面会有更多政策倾斜，对你在澳大利亚的执业环境有潜在影响。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构任命原住民和托雷斯海峡岛民健康战略部门新负责人
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构（Ahpra）宣布任命原住民和托雷斯海峡岛民健康战略部门的新负责人。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (Ahpra) has appointed a new head for its Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Strategy Unit. While an administrative appointment, such moves may signal future policy emphasis on culturally safe healthcare and diverse practice, potentially impacting your practice environment in Australia.

items.title: Effectiveness of In-Clinic Rehabilitation vs. Home-Based Telerehabilitation for Adults with MS in the Deep South: The TEAMS Cluster Randomized Trial.
items.summary: The TEAMS cluster-randomized trial of 759 adults with MS found no significant difference in effectiveness between a 12-week complementary and alternative medicine (CAM) program delivered in-clinic by a therapist (DirectCAM, n=382) versus self-initiated at home via telerehabilitation (TeleCAM, n=377).
items.curatedReason: TEAMS 试验显示，对于多发性硬化症患者，居家远程康复与诊所康复在效果上并无显著差异。这意味着你可以放心地为部分患者提供居家远程方案，扩展服务覆盖。
items.titleZh: 美国南部多发性硬化症成人患者诊所康复与居家远程康复有效性比较：TEAMS 集群随机试验
items.summaryZh: TEAMS 集群随机对照试验发现，对于759名多发性硬化症成人患者，由治疗师在诊所提供的12周辅助与替代医学（CAM）项目（DirectCAM, n=382）与居家自行启动的远程康复（TeleCAM, n=377）在有效性方面无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: The TEAMS trial indicates no significant difference in effectiveness between home-based telerehabilitation and in-clinic rehabilitation for MS patients. This allows you to confidently offer home-based telehealth options for some patients, expanding service reach.
items.limitation: 研究仅限于美国南部地区的MS患者，且只评估了12周的CAM项目。
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Experiences of telehealth e-mentoring within postgraduate musculoskeletal physical therapy education in Canada and the United Kingdom.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored the experiences of postgraduate physiotherapy mentees and mentors in telehealth e-mentoring in Canada, comparing findings with the UK to understand cross-cultural applicability in musculoskeletal physical therapy education.
items.curatedReason: 远程电子导师制在研究生骨骼肌肉物理治疗教育中展现出潜力，尤其在跨文化应用方面。你可以借鉴其在加拿大和英国的经验，优化自身教育或培训项目中的导师机制。
items.titleZh: 远程电子导师制在加拿大和英国研究生骨骼肌肉物理治疗教育中的经验
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了加拿大研究生物理治疗学员和导师在远程电子导师制中的经验，并与英国的情况进行了比较，以了解其在骨骼肌肉物理治疗教育中跨文化应用的潜力。
items.curatedReasonEn: Telehealth e-mentoring shows potential in postgraduate musculoskeletal physical therapy education, particularly for cross-cultural application. You can leverage the experiences from Canada and the UK to optimize mentoring mechanisms in your own educational or training programs.
items.limitation: 研究为定性设计，未提供量化效果数据，且探索的是主观体验。
items.limitationEn: The study employed a qualitative design, providing no quantitative effectiveness data, and focused on subjective experiences.

items.title: Foot-Targeted Rehabilitation for Pronation-Related Anterior Knee Pain: A Two-Phase Case-Control Study and Single-Blind Randomized Controlled Trial of Manual Therapy Versus Neuromuscular Training Each With Augmented Low-Dye Taping.
items.summary: A two-phase study found that neuromuscular training with augmented low-dye taping (NMT + ALDT) was more effective in the short term for pronation-related anterior knee pain compared to routine physiotherapy care.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提示，对膝前痛合并足部旋前的患者，足部靶向治疗可能优于常规PT。特别是神经肌肉训练联用低染料贴扎（NMT + ALDT），短期效果显著。
items.titleZh: 足部靶向康复治疗旋前相关膝前痛：一项病例对照研究和单盲随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项两阶段研究发现，对于旋前相关膝前痛，神经肌肉训练联合加强型低染料贴扎（NMT + ALDT）在短期内效果优于常规物理治疗。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that foot-targeted therapy may be superior to routine PT for anterior knee pain with foot pronation. Specifically, neuromuscular training with augmented low-dye taping (NMT + ALDT) shows significant short-term effects.
items.limitation: 研究设计复杂，但可能存在分组不均衡和短期随访的局限性。
items.limitationEn: The study has a complex design but may be limited by imbalanced groups and short-term follow-up.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Incidence and risk factors for rotator cuff retear after arthroscopic rotator cuff repair in middle-aged and older patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: This systematic review and meta-analysis investigated the incidence and risk factors for rotator cuff retear after arthroscopic repair in middle-aged and older patients.
items.curatedReason: 肩袖修复术后翻修是临床难题。这份系统综述和荟萃分析提供了中年及老年患者术后翻修率的汇总数据及风险因素，为你在术后康复评估和风险沟通时提供了重要的循证依据。
items.titleZh: 中年及老年患者关节镜下肩袖修复术后肩袖再撕裂的发生率及风险因素：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析考察了中年及老年患者关节镜下肩袖修复术后肩袖再撕裂的发生率及风险因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: Rotator cuff retear after repair is a clinical challenge. This systematic review and meta-analysis provides pooled data on retear rates and risk factors in middle-aged and older patients, offering crucial evidence for your post-operative rehabilitation assessment and risk communication.
items.limitation: 研究未详细说明纳入的各项研究中患者的康复方案差异，这可能影响翻修率的解读。
items.limitationEn: The study did not detail the rehabilitation protocol variations across included studies, which might influence the interpretation of retear rates.

items.title: Effects of functional versus conventional Physiotherapy-Based pain management on symptoms, psychological outcomes, and quality of life in women with Bladder Pain Syndrome: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=28) found that functional physiotherapy (pain science education, cognition-targeted exercises) improved symptoms, psychological outcomes, and quality of life in women with Bladder Pain Syndrome compared to conventional TENS.
items.curatedReason: 这项小样本 RCT 提示，对于膀胱疼痛综合征患者，结合疼痛教育和认知靶向运动的功能性物理治疗，可能在症状、心理和生活质量方面优于传统电刺激方案。评估不同物理治疗方案时，考虑其更全面的干预潜力。
items.titleZh: 功能性与传统物理治疗对膀胱疼痛综合征女性患者症状、心理结局及生活质量的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对28名膀胱疼痛综合征女性患者的随机对照试验发现，功能性物理治疗（疼痛科学教育、认知靶向运动）在症状、心理结局和生活质量方面优于传统经皮电刺激（TENS）方案。
items.curatedReasonEn: This small RCT suggests that functional physiotherapy, incorporating pain education and cognitive-targeted exercises, may offer broader benefits in symptoms, psychological outcomes, and quality of life for bladder pain syndrome patients compared to conventional TENS. Consider the comprehensive intervention potential when evaluating different PT approaches.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（n=28），且评估时间点未明确，可能限制结果的普适性。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (n=28) and unclear assessment time points, which may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Association between the Chinese version of the Mediterranean-DASH intervention for Neurodegenerative Delay diet and BADL/IADL disability among older adults in China: a nationwide survey
items.summary: A nationwide survey in China explored the association between adherence to the Chinese version of the Mediterranean-DASH Intervention for Neurodegenerative Delay (MIND) diet and BADL/IADL disability among older adults.
items.curatedReason: MIND 饮食法与老年人神经退行性疾病风险相关。这项全国性调查揭示了中国老年人采用 MIND 饮食与日常生活活动能力（BADL/IADL）残疾之间的关联，为你理解营养干预在老年康复中的作用提供了中国本土证据。
items.titleZh: 中国老年人地中海-DASH神经退行性延迟饮食中国版与BADL/IADL残疾的关联：一项全国性调查
items.summaryZh: 中国一项全国性调查探讨了中国版地中海-DASH神经退行性延迟饮食（MIND饮食）与老年人基本和工具性日常生活活动能力（BADL/IADL）残疾之间的关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: The MIND diet is linked to neurodegenerative disease risk in older adults. This nationwide survey reveals the association between the Chinese version of the MIND diet and BADL/IADL disability in older Chinese adults, providing local evidence for understanding nutritional interventions in geriatric rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面调查，无法确立MIND饮食与BADL/IADL残疾之间的因果关系。
items.limitationEn: As a cross-sectional survey, this study cannot establish a causal relationship between the MIND diet and BADL/IADL disability.

items.title: Association of the GAP score and roussouly-based algorithm with long-term patient-reported outcomes following adult spinal deformity surgery: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: This systematic review and meta-analysis investigated the association of the GAP score and Roussouly-based algorithm with long-term patient-reported outcomes following adult spinal deformity surgery.
items.curatedReason: 对于成人脊柱畸形术后患者，GAP评分和Roussouly分型算法的预后价值至关重要。这份系统综述和荟萃分析评估了它们与长期患者报告结局的关联，为你的康复预后判断和多学科沟通提供了新的证据。
items.titleZh: GAP评分和基于Roussouly的算法与成人脊柱畸形手术后长期患者报告结局的关联：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析探讨了GAP评分和基于Roussouly的算法与成人脊柱畸形手术后长期患者报告结局之间的关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: For adult spinal deformity patients post-surgery, the prognostic value of GAP score and Roussouly-based algorithms is crucial. This systematic review and meta-analysis assesses their association with long-term patient-reported outcomes, providing new evidence for your rehabilitation prognosis and multidisciplinary communication.
items.limitation: 综述可能存在纳入研究异质性高的问题，需要对结果的普适性保持谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The review might have high heterogeneity among included studies, requiring caution regarding the generalizability of the results.

items.title: Injury epidemiology in HYROX athletes: an international cross-sectional survey
items.summary: An international cross-sectional survey investigated the injury epidemiology among HYROX athletes.
items.curatedReason: HYROX 是一项新兴的混合健身运动，了解其运动员的损伤流行病学，有助于你更好地为这类群体设计预防和康复方案，识别常见的运动风险。
