items.summaryZh: 一项对 140 名大学生的病例对照研究发现，在调整年龄、性别和 BMI 后，偏头痛与核心肌群和颈部肌肉耐力下降以及颅椎角异常存在关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case-control study supports the association between migraine and reduced cervical muscle endurance and postural alterations. For young adults with migraine, assessing and addressing cervical musculoskeletal dysfunction is a promising approach to integrate into rehabilitation plans.
items.limitation: 病例对照设计无法确立因果关系，且研究人群仅限于大学生，外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The case-control design cannot establish causality, and the study population is limited to university students, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Associations of motor recovery and perceived social support with participation-related outcomes in chronic stroke.
items.summary: This cross-sectional study of 40 chronic stroke survivors found that both motor recovery and perceived social support are associated with participation-related outcomes, with varying impacts on different domains such as life satisfaction and health-related quality of life.
items.curatedReason: 运动功能恢复和社会支持对卒中患者的参与度均有积极影响，但两者对不同参与结局的影响程度和模式有异。在评估和干预时，你需要细化目标，考虑社会支持干预对生活满意度等主观指标的独特价值。
items.titleZh: 慢性卒中患者运动功能恢复和社会支持与参与度相关结局的关联
items.summaryZh: 这项对 40 名慢性卒中幸存者的横断面研究发现，运动功能恢复和感知的社会支持均与参与度相关结局相关，但对生活满意度和健康相关生活质量等不同领域的影响存在差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Both motor recovery and social support positively influence participation outcomes in stroke survivors, but their impact varies across different domains of participation. When assessing and intervening, you need to refine your goals and consider the unique value of social support interventions for subjective outcomes like life satisfaction.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, which precludes the establishment of causality.

items.title: Feasibility and acceptability of a randomized controlled trial of a patient-centred transition program for stroke survivors and their caregivers-P-NAVISTROKE study.
items.summary: This pilot randomized controlled trial with 28 stroke survivors and 9 caregivers found a patient-centered transition program combining an information platform and case manager follow-up to be feasible and acceptable, addressing psychosocial recovery during hospital-to-home transition.
items.curatedReason: 这项试点 RCT 表明，以患者为中心的卒中居家过渡计划是可行且可接受的。虽然目前主要验证可行性，但它提示你，在卒中患者出院到居家期间，结合信息平台和个案管理师随访的模式可能有效缓解其心理社会恢复中的支持不足。
items.titleZh: 卒中幸存者及其照护者的以患者为中心的过渡计划——P-NAVISTROKE 研究的随机对照试验可行性与可接受性
items.summaryZh: 这项针对 28 名卒中幸存者和 9 名照护者的试点随机对照试验发现，结合信息平台和个案管理师随访的以患者为中心的过渡计划是可行且可接受的，旨在解决卒中患者出院回家期间的心理社会恢复问题。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot RCT demonstrates that a patient-centered stroke transition program to home is feasible and acceptable. While primarily validating feasibility, it suggests that a model combining an information platform with case manager follow-up could effectively address the lack of psychosocial support for stroke survivors during their hospital-to-home transition.
items.limitation: 这是一项探索可行性和可接受性的试点研究，样本量小（28 名卒中幸存者和 9 名照护者），未评估临床疗效。
items.limitationEn: This is a pilot study exploring feasibility and acceptability with a small sample size (28 stroke survivors and 9 caregivers), and did not evaluate clinical efficacy.

items.title: Effects of tDCS combined with unstable resistance training on knee muscle strength and neuromuscular control in community-dwelling older adults: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial found that transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) combined with unstable resistance training improved knee muscle strength, neuromuscular control, and balance in community-dwelling older adults.
items.curatedReason: tDCS 结合不稳定抗阻训练可以改善老年人的膝关节肌力、神经肌肉控制和平衡，为临床提供了额外的干预选择。
items.titleZh: tDCS 结合不稳定抗阻训练对社区老年人膝关节肌力及神经肌肉控制的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验发现，经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）结合不稳定抗阻训练可以改善社区老年人的膝关节肌力、神经肌肉控制和平衡。
items.curatedReasonEn: tDCS combined with unstable resistance training can improve knee muscle strength, neuromuscular control, and balance in older adults, offering an additional intervention option for clinicians.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小，且受试者为社区居住老年人，结果外推性需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study had a relatively small sample size, and participants were community-dwelling older adults, so the generalizability of the results requires caution.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Effect of a multidisciplinary intensive outpatient rehabilitation program on plasma neurofilaments and myokines in Parkinson’s disease: an exploratory analysis
items.summary: An exploratory analysis found that a multidisciplinary intensive outpatient rehabilitation program improved plasma neurofilaments and myokines in Parkinson's disease patients.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性分析提示多学科强化门诊康复项目能改善帕金森病患者的血浆神经丝和肌因子水平，这为理解康复机制提供了生物标志物证据，有助于你优化帕金森病康复方案。
items.titleZh: 多学科强化门诊康复项目对帕金森病患者血浆神经丝和肌因子影响的探索性分析
items.summaryZh: 一项探索性分析发现，多学科强化门诊康复项目改善了帕金森病患者的血浆神经丝和肌因子水平。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory analysis suggests that a multidisciplinary intensive outpatient rehabilitation program can improve plasma neurofilament and myokine levels in Parkinson's disease patients. This provides biomarker evidence for understanding rehabilitation mechanisms and helps you optimize Parkinson's disease rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: 研究为探索性分析，样本量较小，且未设立对照组，难以确证干预的直接因果效应。
items.limitationEn: The study is an exploratory analysis with a small sample size and no control group, making it difficult to confirm the direct causal effects of the intervention.

items.title: AI-assisted exercise prescription in rheumatology: a comparative evaluation of three large language models for personalized APA prescription
items.summary: A comparative evaluation of three large language models for personalized Adapted Physical Activity (APA) prescription in rheumatology showed promising results for AI-assisted exercise prescription.
items.curatedReason: 大型语言模型在风湿病患者个性化 APA 处方中展现出潜力，提示 AI 辅助处方是未来趋势。但在实际应用前，你仍需关注其准确性和临床验证，不能盲目采纳。
items.titleZh: 风湿病学中 AI 辅助运动处方：三种大型语言模型个性化适应性体育活动处方的比较评估
items.summaryZh: 一项针对三种大型语言模型在风湿病患者个性化适应性体育活动（APA）处方中的比较评估显示，AI 辅助运动处方前景可观。
items.curatedReasonEn: Large language models show promise in personalized APA prescription for rheumatology patients, suggesting AI-assisted prescribing is a future trend. However, before clinical application, you must still pay attention to its accuracy and clinical validation, and not adopt it blindly.
items.limitation: 研究主要基于模型生成，缺乏真实患者的临床试验验证其效果和安全性。
items.limitationEn: The study is primarily based on model generation and lacks clinical trial validation of its effectiveness and safety in real patients.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Mepivacaine Provides Greater Short-Term Relief Than Dry Needling and Local Lidocaine for Myofascial Pain: Study
items.summary: A study reported that mepivacaine provided greater short-term relief for myofascial pain compared to dry needling and local lidocaine injections.
items.curatedReason: 这项新闻报道的研究指出，布比卡因在短期疼痛缓解方面优于干针和利多卡因，为你提供了不同治疗手段效果的比较信息，但在实践中仍需综合考虑长期效果和患者偏好。
items.titleZh: 研究：布比卡因在肌筋膜疼痛短期缓解方面优于干针和局部利多卡因
items.summaryZh: 一项研究报告称，布比卡因在肌筋膜疼痛的短期缓解效果上优于干针疗法和局部利多卡因注射。
items.curatedReasonEn: Mepivacaine reportedly provides greater short-term relief for myofascial pain compared to dry needling and local lidocaine injections. This offers you comparative information on treatment efficacy, but in clinical practice, you should still consider long-term effects and patient preferences.
items.limitation: 该报道源自第三方新闻平台，缺乏对原始研究设计和方法学细节的深入披露，信息可能不完整。
items.limitationEn: This report originates from a third-party news platform, lacking in-depth disclosure of the original study's design and methodological details, which may lead to incomplete information.

items.title: Latent profile analysis of health literacy in elderly patients after PCI
items.summary: A latent profile analysis identified distinct health literacy profiles among elderly patients after percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI), highlighting heterogeneity in their understanding and engagement with health information.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究通过潜在剖面分析揭示了 PCI 术后老年患者健康素养的不同模式，为你理解此类患者的异质性提供了视角，但与物理治疗直接相关的干预信息较少。
items.titleZh: PCI 术后老年患者健康素养的潜在剖面分析
items.summaryZh: 一项潜在剖面分析识别出经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）术后老年患者不同的健康素养模式，凸显了他们在理解和参与健康信息方面的异质性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Distinct health literacy profiles exist among elderly patients after PCI, as revealed by this latent profile analysis, highlighting their heterogeneity. This offers you a perspective on individual differences in this patient group, but direct physical therapy intervention information remains limited.
items.limitation: 研究为横断面设计，无法揭示健康素养模式随时间的变化及其对长期结局的影响。
items.limitationEn: The study has a cross-sectional design, which limits its ability to reveal changes in health literacy patterns over time and their impact on long-term outcomes.

items.title: A grade-specific clinical prediction rule for independent walking after traumatic spinal cord injury.
items.summary: A clinical prediction rule was developed using the National Spinal Cord Injury Statistical Centre dataset (2607 patients) to predict independent walking one year after traumatic SCI, identifying grade-specific predictors.
items.curatedReason: 这个基于大样本数据集开发的临床预测规则，能根据 ASIA 损伤分级为创伤性脊髓损伤患者提供一年后独立步行的差异化预后，对于制定康复计划和管理患者期望很有价值。
items.titleZh: 创伤性脊髓损伤后独立行走的等级特异性临床预测规则
items.summaryZh: 一项研究利用全国脊髓损伤统计中心数据集（2607 名患者）开发了一个临床预测规则，旨在预测创伤性脊髓损伤患者一年后的独立行走能力，并识别了与损伤等级相关的预测因子。
items.curatedReasonEn: This clinical prediction rule, developed using a large dataset, provides differentiated prognosis for independent walking one year after traumatic spinal cord injury based on ASIA Impairment Scale grades, valuable for rehabilitation planning and managing patient expectations.
items.limitation: 预测变量的选择和机器学习模型建立的细节需进一步公开，以评估其稳健性和可解释性。
items.limitationEn: Further details on the selection of predictive variables and the establishment of machine learning models are needed to assess robustness and interpretability.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Analysis of Home-Based Rehabilitation Robotics: Lessons Learned from Nationwide Direct-to-Consumer Deployment.
items.summary: An analysis discusses the lessons learned from nationwide direct-to-consumer deployment of home-based rehabilitation robotics for stroke survivors, highlighting potential workforce multipliers for neurorehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 这篇分析总结了美国居家康复机器人部署的经验教训，对评估新技术在卒中康复中的潜力、挑战和扩大规模至关重要。
items.titleZh: 居家康复机器人分析：全国性消费者直达部署的经验教训
items.summaryZh: 一项分析讨论了美国卒中幸存者居家康复机器人在全国范围内直接面向消费者部署的经验教训，强调了其在神经康复中作为劳动力乘数的潜力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This analysis summarizes lessons learned from home-based rehabilitation robotics deployment in the US, crucial for evaluating the potential, challenges, and scalability of new technologies in stroke rehabilitation.

items.title: Have conflicts of interest in manual therapy trials for low back pain been transparent? A meta-epidemiological review.
items.summary: A meta-epidemiological review identified and compared study-disclosed conflicts of interest with externally discovered ones in manual therapy trials for low back pain published between 2000 and 2025.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述揭示了手动疗法试验中利益冲突披露的潜在不足，提醒我们在评估相关研究证据时需对透明度保持警惕。
items.titleZh: 腰痛手动疗法试验中的利益冲突披露是否透明？一项荟萃流行病学综述
items.summaryZh: 一项荟萃流行病学综述旨在评估 2000 年至 2025 年间发表的腰痛手动疗法试验中利益冲突的披露情况，并与外部搜索结果进行比较。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review highlights potential shortcomings in conflict of interest disclosures within manual therapy trials, urging vigilance regarding transparency when evaluating related research evidence.
items.limitation: 研究范围仅限于 2000 年至 2025 年间发表的针对非特异性腰痛的手动疗法试验。
items.limitationEn: The study is limited to manual therapy trials for nonspecific low back pain published between 2000 and 2025.

items.title: Efficacy of Transcranial Direct Current Stimulation in Acute Ischemic Stroke: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Stimulation Montages and Timing.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 10 RCTs (N=419) found that active tDCS significantly reduced neurological deficits (WMD=-0.86, 95% CI: -1.38 to -0.34, P=0.001) compared to sham stimulation in acute ischemic stroke, but did not significantly improve motor function.
items.curatedReason: 对于急性缺血性卒中，经颅直流电刺激 (tDCS) 在减少神经功能缺损方面显示出显著益处，这一结果支持其作为急性期辅助干预手段的潜力。但对运动功能改善的效应仍需更多研究。在你考虑在急性卒中患者中使用 tDCS 时，可参考此证据。
items.titleZh: 经颅直流电刺激在急性缺血性卒中中的疗效：刺激模式与时机的系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对 10 项 RCT（N=419）的系统综述和 Meta 分析发现，在急性缺血性卒中中，主动经颅直流电刺激 (tDCS) 相比假刺激显著减少了神经功能缺损 (WMD=-0.86, 95% CI: -1.38 to -0.34, P=0.001)，但对运动功能没有显著改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: Transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) shows significant benefits in reducing neurological deficits in acute ischemic stroke, supporting its potential as an adjunctive intervention during the acute phase. However, its effect on motor function improvement requires further research. Consider this evidence when evaluating tDCS for acute stroke patients.
items.limitation: 研究未显著改善上肢和下肢运动功能，且纳入研究数量和样本量相对较小。
items.limitationEn: The study did not significantly improve upper and lower limb motor function, and the number of included studies and sample sizes were relatively small.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Post-stroke smoking and mental health burden: sex-specific analysis of NHIS 2019-2023.
items.summary: A cross-sectional analysis of NHIS 2019-2023 data (N=150,220 adults) revealed significant associations between stroke history, mental health burden, and smoking, highlighting the need for integrated behavioral health in stroke rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后吸烟和精神健康问题（抑郁/焦虑）在康复患者中普遍存在，且与康复依从性和预后直接相关。这份分析强调了将这些行为健康因素整合到常规卒中康复护理中的必要性。
items.titleZh: 卒中后吸烟与精神健康负担：NHIS 2019-2023 的性别特异性分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对 2019-2023 年 NHIS 数据的横断面分析（N=150,220 名成人）显示，卒中史、精神健康负担和吸烟之间存在显著关联，强调了卒中康复中整合行为健康干预的必要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Post-stroke smoking and mental health burdens (depression/anxiety) are prevalent and directly impact rehabilitation engagement and outcomes. This analysis underscores the necessity of integrating these behavioral health factors into routine stroke rehabilitation care.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面分析，无法建立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This was a cross-sectional analysis, which cannot establish causality.

items.title: Measurement properties of a 300-m community-based walking test incorporating environmental walking demands in individuals with subacute stroke.
items.summary: A study evaluated the measurement properties of a 300-m Community-Based Walking Test (CBWT) in 26 individuals with subacute stroke, finding strong test-retest reliability (ICC 2,1) in both forward and reverse directions.
items.curatedReason: 这个 300 米社区步行测试的测量学特性很扎实，可以作为亚急性卒中患者评估步态耐力的一个补充工具，尤其是在模拟真实环境挑战方面有优势。
items.titleZh: 亚急性卒中患者 300 米社区步行测试测量学特性研究，融入环境步行需求
items.summaryZh: 一项研究评估了 26 名亚急性卒中患者的 300 米社区步行测试（CBWT）的测量学特性，结果显示其在正向和反向均具有很强的重测信度（ICC 2,1）。
items.curatedReasonEn: The robust psychometric properties of this 300-m Community-Based Walking Test make it a valuable supplementary tool for assessing gait endurance in subacute stroke patients, particularly for its ability to simulate real-world environmental walking demands.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（26人），可能影响结果的外推性。
items.limitationEn: The study's small sample size (26 individuals) may limit the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Beyond Conventional Therapy in Parkinson's Disease Patients: The Impact of Visual Feedback Training on Balance and Trunk Control - A Prospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: A 4-week program combining conventional physiotherapy with visual-feedback balance and trunk-control training improved balance, mobility, and functional independence in 21 Parkinson's disease patients (Hoehn and Yahr stages 1-3).
items.curatedReason: 视觉反馈训练平台配合传统物理治疗，可显著改善帕金森病患者的平衡、步态和躯干控制。将视觉反馈技术整合到你的康复方案中，为这类患者提供额外支持。
items.titleZh: 帕金森病患者的视觉反馈训练：对平衡和躯干控制的影响——一项前瞻性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 4 周、结合传统物理治疗和视觉反馈平衡与躯干控制训练的项目，改善了 21 名帕金森病（Hoehn-Yahr 1-3 期）患者的平衡、活动能力和功能独立性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Visual feedback training platforms combined with conventional physiotherapy significantly improve balance, gait, and trunk control in Parkinson's disease patients. Consider integrating visual feedback technology into your rehabilitation protocols for added support in this population.
items.limitation: 本研究为前瞻性队列研究，缺乏随机对照组，可能存在混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: This was a prospective cohort study lacking a randomized control group, which may introduce confounding factors.

items.title: Visually identified breakpoints in muscle oxygen saturation are not equivalent to ventilatory thresholds in national-level triathletes
items.summary: This study found that visually identified breakpoints in muscle oxygen saturation (SmO2) from portable near-infrared spectroscopy (NIRS) are not equivalent to ventilatory thresholds in national-level triathletes, suggesting SmO2 breakpoints are not a reliable substitute for delineating exercise intensity domains.
items.curatedReason: 请注意，在评估国家级铁人三项运动员的运动强度时，SmO2 的拐点不能简单替代通气阈值。这项研究表明两者不等同，若你仅依赖 SmO2，可能会导致训练强度划分不准确。
items.titleZh: 国家级铁人三项运动员肌肉氧饱和度的目视识别拐点与通气阈值不等同
items.summaryZh: 这项研究发现，便携式近红外光谱（NIRS）观察到的肌肉氧饱和度（SmO2）目视识别拐点与国家级铁人三项运动员的通气阈值不等同，提示 SmO2 拐点不是划分运动强度区域的可靠替代指标。
items.curatedReasonEn: Be aware that SmO2 breakpoints are not simply interchangeable with ventilatory thresholds when assessing exercise intensity in national-level triathletes. This study indicates they are not equivalent; relying solely on SmO2 may lead to inaccurate training intensity demarcation.
items.limitation: 研究对象仅为国家级铁人三项运动员，结果外推至其他人群或运动项目时需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study subjects were national-level triathletes only, so results should be generalized to other populations or sports with caution.

items.title: Clinical and neurophysiological determinants of response to contralesional low-frequency repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation after stroke: A systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: This systematic review and meta-analysis of RCTs (up to July 2026) found that contralesional low-frequency repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (LF-rTMS) effectively improves post-stroke upper-limb function, with treatment effects modulated by baseline motor impairment and corticospinal tract integrity.
items.curatedReason: 对侧低频重复经颅磁刺激（LF-rTMS）确实能改善卒中后上肢功能，这篇系统综述再次确认了这一点。但请注意，它的疗效受到患者基线运动障碍严重程度和皮质脊髓束完整性的影响，这意味着在筛选患者和调整方案时，你需要把这些因素考虑进去。
items.titleZh: 卒中后对侧低频重复经颅磁刺激反应的临床和神经生理学决定因素：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 这项针对 RCT 的系统综述和荟萃分析（截至 2026 年 7 月）发现，对侧低频重复经颅磁刺激（LF-rTMS）可有效改善卒中后上肢功能，其治疗效果受基线运动障碍和皮质脊髓束完整性的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: Contralesional low-frequency repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (LF-rTMS) does improve post-stroke upper-limb function, and this systematic review reinforces that. However, be mindful that its efficacy is modulated by baseline motor impairment severity and corticospinal tract integrity, so factor these into your patient screening and treatment planning.
items.limitation: 尽管是系统综述和荟萃分析，但纳入的原始研究在刺激参数和康复方案上仍可能存在异质性，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: Although a systematic review and meta-analysis, heterogeneity in stimulation parameters and rehabilitation protocols among included original studies may affect the generalizability of the results.

items.title: Modest Payment Increases Finalized by CMS for SNFs and IRFs
items.summary: CMS finalized modest payment increases for skilled nursing facilities (SNFs) and inpatient rehabilitation facilities (IRFs) for fiscal year 2027, with new rules expected to increase the burden on facilities for delivering, coordinating, and documenting patient care.
items.curatedReason: CMS 最终确定了 2027 财年专业护理机构（SNF）和住院康复机构（IRF）的适度支付增长。虽然增长幅度不大，但新规则增加了设施在患者护理交付、协调和文件记录方面的负担，这直接影响你在这些机构中的执业实践和工作流程。
items.titleZh: CMS 最终确定 SNF 和 IRF 的适度支付增长
items.summaryZh: CMS 最终确定了 2027 财年专业护理机构（SNF）和住院康复机构（IRF）的适度支付增长，预计新规则将增加设施在患者护理交付、协调和文件记录方面的负担。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS has finalized modest payment increases for skilled nursing facilities (SNFs) and inpatient rehabilitation facilities (IRFs) for FY 2027. While the increases are small, the new rules impose increased burdens on facilities for patient care delivery, coordination, and documentation, directly impacting your practice and workflow in these settings.

items.title: Effects of battle rope training on sporting performance: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated the effects of battle rope training on sporting performance, including upper-limb and lower-limb explosive power, grip strength, upper-limb muscular endurance, and core endurance, following PRISMA 2020 guidelines.
items.curatedReason: 如果你正在为运动员或高水平训练者寻找提升表现的有效方法，战绳训练是一个值得考虑的选择。这项系统综述和荟萃分析确认了战绳训练能显著提高上肢和下肢爆发力、握力、上肢肌肉耐力以及核心耐力。你可以放心地将战绳训练整合到你的训练方案中。
items.titleZh: 战绳训练对运动表现的影响：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析根据 PRISMA 2020 指南，评估了战绳训练对运动表现的影响，包括上肢和下肢爆发力、握力、上肢肌肉耐力和核心耐力。
items.curatedReasonEn: If you are looking for effective ways to enhance performance for athletes or high-level trainees, battle rope training (BRT) is a viable option. This systematic review and meta-analysis confirms that BRT significantly improves upper and lower-limb explosive power, grip strength, upper-limb muscular endurance, and core endurance. You can confidently integrate BRT into your training programs.
items.limitation: 荟萃分析可能存在研究间异质性，影响结果的统一性。
items.limitationEn: Heterogeneity between studies in the meta-analysis may affect the uniformity of the results.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Impact of modified subvastus approach versus limited medial parapatellar approach on early recovery after minimally invasive total knee arthroplasty: a retrospective comparative study
items.summary: This retrospective comparative study investigated the impact of a modified subvastus approach versus a limited medial parapatellar approach on early recovery after minimally invasive total knee arthroplasty.
items.curatedReason: 在微创全膝关节置换术（TKA）后，选择不同的手术入路对早期恢复可能存在影响。这项回顾性研究提示，改良的股内侧肌下入路或许与更快的早期恢复相关。虽然只是观察性数据，但它为你在与外科医生协作时，讨论 TKA 术式选择和制定术后康复计划提供了初步参考。
items.titleZh: 改良股内侧肌下入路与有限内侧髌旁入路对微创全膝关节置换术早期恢复的影响：一项回顾性比较研究
items.summaryZh: 这项回顾性比较研究调查了改良股内侧肌下入路与有限内侧髌旁入路对微创全膝关节置换术早期恢复的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: Different surgical approaches in minimally invasive total knee arthroplasty (TKA) might impact early recovery. This retrospective study suggests that a modified subvastus approach could be associated with faster early recovery. While observational, this provides an initial reference for you when collaborating with surgeons, discussing TKA surgical options, and planning postoperative rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 回顾性研究设计可能存在选择偏倚和混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: The retrospective study design may have selection bias and confounding factors.

items.title: How occupational therapists integrate robotic therapy into routine practice: a qualitative study.
items.summary: This qualitative study explored how occupational therapists in Bangkok, Thailand, integrate robotic hand exoskeleton therapy into routine stroke rehabilitation, identifying five themes including client readiness and motivation for robotic use.
items.curatedReason: 将机器人手部外骨骼疗法引入卒中康复，需要重点关注患者的准备度和动机，这直接影响治疗成效。本研究揭示了泰国OT在此方面的实践经验，值得我们思考如何在不同文化背景下有效筛选和准备患者。
items.titleZh: 职业治疗师如何将机器人疗法整合到常规实践中：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 这项定性研究探讨了泰国曼谷的职业治疗师如何将机器人手部外骨骼疗法整合到常规卒中康复实践中，归纳出五个主题，包括患者使用机器人的准备度和动机。
items.curatedReasonEn: Integrating robotic hand exoskeleton therapy into stroke rehab demands careful consideration of client readiness and motivation, as this directly impacts treatment outcomes. This study from Thailand highlights practical considerations from OTs, prompting us to reflect on effective patient selection and preparation across diverse cultural contexts.
items.limitation: 研究样本量小，且仅在泰国曼谷两家机构进行，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size and was conducted in only two occupational therapy services in Bangkok, Thailand, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Early Emergence of Abnormal Muscle Synergies in the Human Upper Extremity Following Stroke
items.summary: This cross-sectional study of 39 early subacute stroke patients (within 6 months) performing reaching movements revealed the early emergence of abnormal muscle synergies in the upper extremity, similar to patterns seen in chronic stroke.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提供了关于卒中后异常肌肉协同模式早期出现的证据。这提示你，对早期卒中患者的评估应关注这些模式，以期可能进行早期干预。
items.titleZh: 卒中后人体上肢异常肌肉协同模式的早期出现
items.summaryZh: 这项对 39 名早期亚急性卒中患者（6 个月内）进行伸手动作的横断面研究显示，上肢异常肌肉协同模式在卒中后早期即出现，与慢性卒中中观察到的模式相似。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study provides evidence on the early emergence of abnormal muscle synergies post-stroke. This suggests that your assessment of early stroke patients should focus on these patterns, potentially allowing for earlier intervention.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法追踪异常协同模式随时间演变的过程，且结果尚未经过同行评审。
items.limitationEn: This study is cross-sectional, unable to track the evolution of abnormal synergy patterns over time, and the results have not yet undergone peer review.

items.title: Associations of Walk-and-Turn Spatiotemporal Gait Parameters With Functional Mobility in Children With Cerebral Palsy at GMFCS Levels I and II
items.summary: Spatiotemporal gait parameters during a 5-meter walk-and-turn task, alongside lower extremity muscle strength and limitations of motion, are associated with functional mobility and Gross Motor Function Classification System (GMFCS) level in ambulatory children with cerebral palsy at GMFCS Levels I and II.
items.curatedReason: 在评估 GMFCS I 和 II 级脑瘫患儿时，除了常规步态分析，别忘了 5 米折返走任务中的时空步态参数。这些参数与患儿的活动能力和 GMFCS 分级有明确关联，提示你应更全面地考虑评估维度，尤其要关注肌肉力量和关节活动度。
items.titleZh: 行走-转身时空步态参数与脑瘫儿童功能移动能力的关联
items.summaryZh: 一项研究发现，在 GMFCS I 和 II 级的行走能力脑瘫儿童中，5 米行走-转身任务中的时空步态参数、下肢肌力和运动受限与功能移动能力及 GMFCS 等级相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: When assessing GMFCS I and II children with CP, go beyond standard gait analysis. Spatiotemporal gait parameters during a 5-meter walk-and-turn task, alongside lower extremity muscle strength and ROM, are linked to their functional mobility and GMFCS level. This suggests we should consider these broader assessment dimensions.
items.limitation: 研究仅关注 GMFCS I 和 II 级儿童，结果不适用于更重症的脑瘫患者。
items.limitationEn: The study focused only on GMFCS Levels I and II children, so the results may not be applicable to more severely affected CP patients.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Protective Techniques and Postural Strategies for Individuals With Blindness or Low Vision: A Guide for Clinicians and Patients
items.summary: A guide for clinicians and patients outlines protective techniques and postural strategies for individuals with blindness or low vision, focusing on preventing injuries to the head, face, or upper body, which are not fully addressed by mobility aids.
items.curatedReason: 这份临床指南为盲人或低视力个体提供了保护性技术和姿势策略，尤其强调了头部和上半身损伤的预防。在处理这类患者时，你应将这些策略整合到你的步态和平衡训练中，以降低跌倒及碰撞风险。
items.titleZh: 盲人或低视力个体保护技术和姿势策略：临床医师与患者指南
items.summaryZh: 一份为临床医师和患者提供的指南，概述了盲人或低视力个体的保护性技术和姿势策略，旨在预防头部、面部或上半身损伤，因为这些损伤通常无法通过助行器完全避免。
items.curatedReasonEn: This clinical guide offers protective techniques and postural strategies for individuals with blindness or low vision, with a particular emphasis on preventing head and upper-body injuries. When treating these patients, you should integrate these strategies into your gait and balance training to reduce the risk of falls and collisions.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Tapering and Peaking in the Weight Lifting Sports: A Systematic Review of Athletes’ Self-Reported Strategies
items.summary: A systematic review compiles self-reported strategies used by athletes for tapering and peaking in weightlifting sports, highlighting common practices.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述总结了举重运动员在赛前减量和巅峰期的策略。你可以参考这些常见的自我报告实践，为你的举重运动员提供更个性化、更有效的赛前训练调整指导，帮助他们达到最佳竞技状态。
items.titleZh: 举重运动员赛前减量和巅峰期策略的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述收集了举重运动员在赛前减量和巅峰期策略方面的自我报告数据，强调了常见做法。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review compiles self-reported strategies for tapering and peaking in weightlifting sports. You can use these common practices to offer more personalized and effective pre-competition training adjustments for your weightlifters, helping them achieve peak performance.
items.limitation: 证据来源于运动员的自我报告策略，可能存在回忆偏差和主观性，并非基于客观生理测量。
items.limitationEn: Evidence is based on athletes' self-reported strategies, which may be subject to recall bias and subjectivity, and not based on objective physiological measurements.

items.title: Exploring Factors to Explain Interindividual Responses to Running Economy in Advanced Footwear Technology Shoes: A Randomised Crossover Laboratory Trial with an Explanatory Predictor Analysis
items.summary: A randomized crossover laboratory trial investigates factors explaining interindividual responses to running economy in advanced footwear technology shoes, with an explanatory predictor analysis.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 揭示了高性能跑鞋对跑步经济性的个体反应差异。在为运动员提供跑鞋建议时，请记住这种差异，不要盲目推荐，而应结合个体评估和反馈。
items.titleZh: 高性能跑鞋对跑步经济性的个体反应差异及其解释因素：一项随机交叉实验室试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机交叉实验室试验，通过解释性预测因子分析，探索了高性能跑鞋在提高跑步经济性方面个体反应差异的因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT highlights individual differences in running economy responses to advanced footwear. When advising athletes on shoes, remember this variability; avoid blanket recommendations and instead integrate individual assessments and feedback.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小，且是在实验室环境下进行，其结果在实际跑动场景中的普适性有待验证。
items.limitationEn: The study's sample size is relatively small, and it was conducted in a laboratory setting, so the generalizability of its findings to real-world running scenarios needs further validation.

items.title: Assessing concerns about falling: a comparison of telephone-based and face-to-face FES-I interviews in older adults
items.summary: A study comparing telephone-based and face-to-face interviews for assessing concerns about falling (FES-I) in older adults found comparable results, supporting remote assessment methods.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究发现，电话访谈和面对面访谈在评估老年人跌倒担忧（FES-I）方面效果相当。这意味着你在远程医疗中可以放心地使用电话访谈，这为老年患者的跌倒风险评估提供了便利且有效的途径。
items.titleZh: 电话与面对面访谈评估老年人跌倒担忧的比较研究
items.summaryZh: 一项比较电话和面对面访谈评估老年人跌倒担忧（FES-I）的研究发现结果具有可比性，支持远程评估方法。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study found that telephone and face-to-face interviews are comparable for assessing concerns about falling (FES-I) in older adults. This means you can confidently use telephone interviews in telehealth, providing a convenient and effective way to assess fall risk for elderly patients.
items.limitation: 研究未明确提供参与者的基线特征和具体评估工具的信效度数据，可能影响结果的泛化性。
items.limitationEn: The study does not explicitly provide baseline characteristics of participants or specific reliability and validity data for the assessment tools, which may affect the generalizability of the results.

items.title: Opioids Do Not Relieve Persistent  Breathlessness among COPD patients,  suggests study
items.summary: A study suggests that opioids do not relieve persistent breathlessness among COPD patients, highlighting the need for alternative interventions.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，阿片类药物并不能有效缓解COPD患者的持续性呼吸困难。这提醒你在处理COPD患者呼吸困难时，需要优先考虑非药物干预措施，并将阿片类药物作为辅助或末线选择。
items.titleZh: 研究提示阿片类药物无法缓解 COPD 患者持续性呼吸困难
items.summaryZh: 一项研究表明，阿片类药物无法缓解COPD患者的持续性呼吸困难，强调了替代干预措施的必要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that opioids do not effectively relieve persistent breathlessness in COPD patients. This reminds you to prioritize non-pharmacological interventions when managing breathlessness in COPD patients and consider opioids as an adjunct or last-line option.
items.limitation: 新闻报道未提供原始研究的具体设计和数据，因此无法评估其证据强度和细节。
items.limitationEn: The news report does not provide specific study design and data from the original research, so its evidence strength and details cannot be assessed.

items.title: Neurology | American Board of Physical Therapy Education Residency and Fellowship
items.summary: The American Board of Physical Therapy Residency and Fellowship Education (ABPTRFE) has released a Description of Residency Practice (DRP) for Neurology, aiming to standardize curriculum and streamline accreditation for residency programs.
items.curatedReason: APTA 旗下 ABPTRFE 发布了神经学专业住院医师实践描述 (DRP)，旨在统一神经康复住院医师的培训标准。如果你所在的机构有神经康复住院医师项目，这可以作为课程设计和认证的参考。

items.title: Clean Claims To-Do List for Rehab Therapy Billing Teams
items.summary: WebPT has published a "Clean Claims To-Do List" to guide rehab therapy billing teams in managing and monitoring daily tasks to ensure accurate and error-free claims.
items.curatedReason: WebPT 的这份“清洁索赔待办事项清单”对于康复治疗计费团队来说非常实用。你可以借鉴这份清单来规范你的诊所流程，以确保计费准确无误，从而减少拒付并提高运营效率。
items.titleZh: 康复治疗计费团队的“清洁索赔待办事项清单”

items.curatedReasonEn: WebPT's 'Clean Claims To-Do List' is highly practical for rehabilitation therapy billing teams. You can use this list to standardize your clinic's processes, ensuring accurate billing to reduce denials and improve operational efficiency.

items.title: A qualitative inquiry into the environmental barriers and facilitators to non-specific low back pain clinical practice guideline adherence among Canadian physiotherapists.
items.summary: A qualitative inquiry explored environmental barriers and facilitators influencing Canadian physiotherapists' adherence to non-specific low back pain clinical practice guidelines, identifying key factors across public and private sectors using the Theoretical Domains Framework and Ecological Systems Theory.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了加拿大物理治疗师在非特异性腰痛临床实践指南依从性方面面临的环境障碍和促进因素。了解这些因素有助于优化指南实施策略，提升你在腰痛管理中的临床依从性。
items.titleZh: 加拿大物理治疗师非特异性腰痛临床实践指南依从性的环境障碍与促进因素：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了影响加拿大物理治疗师依从非特异性腰痛临床实践指南的环境障碍和促进因素，通过理论领域框架和生态系统理论识别了公共和私营部门的关键因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals environmental barriers and facilitators to non-specific low back pain clinical practice guideline adherence among Canadian physiotherapists. Understanding these factors can help optimize guideline implementation strategies and improve your clinical adherence in LBP management.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，其发现的普遍性和外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study, and the generalizability and external validity of its findings are limited.

items.title: Outcome measures used in studies of vestibular rehabilitation after stroke: a scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review identified and mapped outcome measures used in studies evaluating vestibular rehabilitation for adults with stroke, systematically searching MEDLINE, Embase, and PEDro to categorize and rank the frequency of their use.
items.curatedReason: 这份范围综述清晰展现了卒中后前庭康复研究中，我们最常用的评估工具是什么。在你设计临床路径或研究方案时，优先考虑这些被广泛接受的结局指标，能更好地与现有证据对话。
items.titleZh: 卒中后前庭康复研究中使用的结局测量：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述识别并梳理了卒中成人前庭康复研究中使用的结局测量指标，系统搜索了MEDLINE、Embase和PEDro数据库以进行分类和频率排序。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review clearly outlines the most frequently used outcome measures in post-stroke vestibular rehabilitation research. When designing your clinical pathways or research protocols, prioritizing these widely accepted measures will allow for better engagement with existing evidence.
items.limitation: 范围综述的性质限制了其对结局测量工具有效性或质量的深入评估。
items.limitationEn: The nature of a scoping review limits its ability to deeply assess the validity or quality of outcome measurement tools.

items.title: Vancomycin-Soaked Quadriceps Grafts Linked to Early Resorption in ACLR: study
items.summary: A study suggests that vancomycin-soaked quadriceps grafts are linked to early resorption following anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction (ACLR).
items.curatedReason: 这项研究指出万古霉素浸泡的股四头肌移植物与ACL重建术后早期吸收有关。这直接影响您在评估和管理ACL重建术后患者时，对移植物稳定性和并发症的预期和监测，尤其是在有药物浸泡史的病例中。
items.titleZh: 研究：万古霉素浸泡的股四头肌移植物与ACL重建术后早期吸收相关
items.summaryZh: 一项研究提示，万古霉素浸泡的股四头肌移植物与前交叉韧带重建术后的早期吸收有关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates a link between vancomycin-soaked quadriceps grafts and early resorption after ACLR. This directly impacts your expectations and monitoring of graft stability and complications when evaluating and managing post-ACLR patients, especially those with a history of soaked grafts.
items.limitation: 新闻报道未提供原始研究的具体细节（如样本量、研究设计），因此结论需谨慎对待。
items.limitationEn: The news report does not provide specific details of the original study (e.g., sample size, study design), so conclusions should be treated with caution.

items.title: Repeated sprint performance and fatigue responses across different movement patterns in amateur soccer players
items.summary: A study investigated repeated sprint performance and fatigue responses across various movement patterns in amateur soccer players.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察研究提示，业余足球运动员在不同运动模式下的重复冲刺表现和疲劳反应有差异。你在设计训练方案时，要考虑这些模式差异，但本研究无法告诉你如何优化。
items.titleZh: 业余足球运动员在不同运动模式下的重复冲刺表现和疲劳反应
items.summaryZh: 一项研究考察了业余足球运动员在不同运动模式下的重复冲刺表现和疲劳反应。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests amateur soccer players show varied repeated sprint performance and fatigue responses across different movement patterns. When designing training, consider these pattern differences, but this study doesn't tell you how to optimize.
items.limitation: 研究对象仅限于业余足球运动员，结果在专业运动员中可能存在差异。
items.limitationEn: The study was limited to amateur soccer players; results may differ for professional athletes.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Federated learning for privacy-preserving collaborative health risk classification using wearable sensor data: validation study with elite football training load monitoring - BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation
items.summary: A validation study demonstrated federated learning's ability to classify health risks using wearable sensor data from elite football players while preserving privacy.
items.curatedReason: 这项验证研究展示了联邦学习在保护精英足球运动员可穿戴传感器数据隐私的同时，进行健康风险分类的潜力。这有助于您在应用技术监控高水平运动员训练负荷时，平衡数据利用与隐私保护的需求。
items.titleZh: 联邦学习在精英足球训练负荷监测中应用于隐私保护协作健康风险分类的验证研究
items.summaryZh: 一项验证研究表明，联邦学习能够在使用可穿戴传感器数据监测精英足球运动员训练负荷时，在保护隐私的前提下进行健康风险分类。
items.curatedReasonEn: This validation study demonstrates the potential of federated learning for privacy-preserving health risk classification using wearable sensor data in elite football players. This helps you balance data utilization with privacy protection when applying technology to monitor training loads in high-level athletes.
items.limitation: 研究的重点在于技术验证，并未直接评估其对临床决策或康复干预的实际影响。
items.limitationEn: The study focuses on technical validation and does not directly assess its practical impact on clinical decision-making or rehabilitation interventions.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Trump Administration Announces $144 million to Improve Mental Health, Substance Abuse, Emergency and Maternal Care and Expand the Healthcare Workforce in Alabama
items.summary: The Trump Administration announced a $144 million allocation to enhance mental health, substance abuse, emergency, and maternal care, and expand the healthcare workforce in Alabama.
items.curatedReason: 美国特朗普政府宣布拨款1.44亿美元用于改善阿拉巴马州的心理健康、药物滥用、急诊和孕产妇护理，并扩大医疗保健劳动力。这笔资金可能影响当地PT的转诊网络和与其他医疗专业人员的协作。

items.summaryZh: 特朗普政府宣布拨款1.44亿美元，用于改善阿拉巴马州的心理健康、药物滥用、急诊和孕产妇护理，并扩大医疗保健劳动力。
